hf.title: StreamEval: Evaluating Interactive Streaming Video Generation Models
hf.abstract: As streaming video generation advances, enabling real-time interaction with generated video is becoming increasingly important. We introduce StreamEval, a unified benchmark for interactive streaming video generation spanning five tasks: avatar dialogue, avatar performance, world generation, instruction editing, and reference editing. StreamEval comprises 300 scripted test cases lasting 15-300s, each specifying initial assets, incrementally arriving multimodal requests, and explicit requirements for state changes and content preservation. Performance is assessed along four evaluation dimensions: task execution, state consistency, visual fidelity, and audiovisual coordination, instantiated through ten task-specific metrics on a 0-100 scale. Evaluating 37 distinct models across 300 test cases, we find that high visual quality and identity retention do not necessarily coincide with reliable request execution or sustained state consistency. In particular, request execution remains challenging: the highest task-specific scores are 36.90 for Following among seven avatar-performance models, 25.93 for Following in text-conditioned world generation, and 15.00 for Edit Success among three reported reference-editing models. These findings identify reliable request execution under timing and preservation constraints as a central challenge for advancing omni-modal real-time interactive systems. The leaderboard is available at https://streameval.ai
hf.titleZh: StreamEval：评估交互式流式视频生成模型
hf.summaryZh: 针对流式视频生成中实时交互能力缺乏统一评测的问题，构建了覆盖虚拟人对话、虚拟人表演、世界生成、指令编辑与参考编辑五类任务的基准，含 300 个时长 15–300 秒的脚本化测试用例，每个用例规定初始素材、增量到达的多模态请求以及状态变化与内容保持的明确要求。评测从任务执行、状态一致性、视觉保真度与视听协调四个维度展开，细化为十项任务相关指标（0–100 分制），共评测 37 个模型。结果显示高视觉质量与身份保持并不等同于可靠的请求执行或持续状态一致性，请求执行尤为困难：七个别虚拟人表演模型中 Following 最高仅 36.90，文本条件世界生成中 Following 为 25.93，三个参考编辑模型中 Edit Success 仅 15.00，表明时序约束与内容保持下的可靠执行是全模态实时交互系统的核心瓶颈。
hf.reason: 视频生成评测基准，主体落在不关注的视觉生成方向

hf.title: Looking Ahead: Modeling Future Evolution in Autoregressive Video Generation
hf.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate videos chunk by chunk, yet producing plausible continuations does not guarantee that they capture how scenes evolve. Under teacher forcing, strong temporal redundancy may allow local visual continuity to serve as a shortcut for current-chunk denoising, reducing the pressure to model visual evolution. We introduce Future Chunk Prediction (FCP), an auxiliary objective jointly optimized with teacher-forced denoising that predicts temporally separated chunks without access to the intervening visual context. Drawing supervision directly from training videos, FCP requires no additional pretrained visual encoder and leaves autoregressive inference unchanged. Our method achieves superior physical plausibility over standard teacher-forced autoregressive training with a lower overall training compute budget, highlighting the effectiveness and efficiency of future-chunk supervision for modeling visual evolution. Intriguingly, our visualizations suggest that FCP fosters a more structured representation space, which may be valuable for building autoregressive world models.
hf.titleZh: 着眼于未来：自回归视频生成中的未来演化建模
hf.summaryZh: 自回归视频扩散模型逐块生成视频，但在 teacher forcing 下，强时序冗余会让局部视觉连续性成为当前块去噪的捷径，模型因而缺少建模场景演化的压力。为此提出未来块预测（FCP）辅助目标：在无法获取中间视觉上下文的情况下预测时间上相隔的块，并与 teacher forcing 去噪联合优化；监督信号直接取自训练视频，无需额外预训练视觉编码器，也不改变自回归推理流程。在更低的总训练算力下，该方法取得了优于标准 teacher forcing 自回归训练的物理合理性。可视化结果提示，FCP 能形成更结构化的表示空间，对构建自回归世界模型可能有价值。
hf.reason: 自回归视频扩散生成，落在视频生成与扩散低分方向

hf.title: DONIC: Generalist Dexterous Bimanual Tracking Control from Human Demonstrations
hf.abstract: Despite recent progress in dexterous reference tracking, existing models focus primarily on single-hand manipulation and a limited range of interactions, leaving the bimanual dexterous behaviors common in real life unaddressed. The scarcity of contact-rich bimanual manipulation data and the increased complexity of coordinating contacts make developing a generalist bimanual tracker particularly challenging. Therefore, we present 1) DONIC, the first generalist bimanual tracker jointly trained across operation categories and human-motion sources, together with 2) BiHOI, a multi-view dataset of 1,575 sequences spanning 229 objects and emphasizing sustained bimanual interaction, where reconstructed interactions are retargeted into robot references. DONIC combines proximal policy optimization with behavioral cloning in a feedback loop that recycles verified successful executions into training demonstrations. An object-centered per-hand reward maintains object-motion feedback while supervising each hand according to its reference contact role. Clip-Centered Advantages remove reference-dependent advantage offsets while preserving within-trajectory differences. Together, these designs enable one single policy to learn coordinated manipulation across heterogeneous references. Without finetuning, a single checkpoint achieves 86.79% success on unseen trajectories of training objects and 57.32% on held-out objects, surpassing the state-of-the-art bimanual tracking baselines by 77.36 and 45.73 percentage points.
hf.titleZh: DONIC：从人类演示学习通用双臂灵巧跟踪控制
hf.summaryZh: 现有灵巧参考跟踪模型多局限于单手操作与有限交互类型，真实场景中常见的双臂灵巧行为尚未被覆盖；接触密集的双臂操作数据稀缺、双手接触协调复杂度高，使通用双臂跟踪器难以构建。工作包含两部分：多视角数据集 BiHOI 含 1575 条序列、229 个物体，强调持续双臂交互，并将重建交互重定向为机器人参考；DONIC 跟踪器把 PPO 与行为克隆置于反馈回路，将验证成功的执行回收为训练演示，并以物体为中心设计单手奖励（按各手的参考接触角色监督），同时用 Clip-Centered Advantages 消除参考相关的优势偏移、保留轨迹内差异。单一策略无需微调，在训练物体的未见轨迹上达 86.79% 成功率、未见物体上 57.32%，分别超过 SOTA 双臂跟踪基线 77.36 与 45.73 个百分点。
hf.reason: 双臂灵巧机器人操作与数据集，属具身智能低分方向

hf.title: SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?
hf.abstract: Spatial intelligence requires agents to actively acquire visual evidence and integrate observations into a coherent representation of the three-dimensional world. Yet spatial question answering offers limited evidence of whether models can construct accurate metric maps through autonomous exploration. We introduce SpatialScout, a benchmark for evaluating vision-language model (VLM) agents on active object-level 3D mapping. SpatialScout comprises 80 diverse indoor scenes containing 3,140 target objects. Given an object inventory, RGB observations, camera calibration, and camera poses, agents control a camera to explore each scene and estimate object centers in a shared coordinate frame. The task requires coordinating viewpoint selection, cross-view association, geometric estimation, and map revision under bounded interaction budgets. Evaluation jointly measures localization accuracy and target coverage through object-scale overlap scores that penalize missing predictions. Experiments with frontier VLMs reveal substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated model, Claude Opus 5.5, achieves a mean overlap score of 41.71%, with 47.23% of targets exceeding an intersection-over-union (IoU) threshold of 0.5 and only 3.25% exceeding 0.9. These results reveal a substantial gap between recovering coarse object layouts and constructing complete, precise metric maps. SpatialScout provides a quantitative testbed for developing agents that build reliable 3D spatial representations through active perception. Code is available at https://github.com/JesseZZZZZ/SpatialScout.
hf.titleZh: SpatialScout：VLM Agent 能否主动探索并构建 3D 场景地图？
hf.summaryZh: 提出SpatialScout基准，以主动建图任务检验VLM Agent的空间智能：含80个室内场景、3140个目标物体，Agent依据物体清单、RGB观测、相机标定与位姿控制相机探索，在统一坐标系中估计物体中心，需在有限交互预算内协调视角选择、跨视图关联、几何估计与地图修正。评测用物体尺度重叠分数同时衡量定位精度与覆盖率，并对漏检施加惩罚。最强模型Claude Opus 5.5平均重叠分仅41.71%，IoU超过0.5的目标占47.23%，超过0.9仅3.25%，说明从粗略布局到完整精确度量地图仍差距显著。
hf.reason: VLM Agent 主动建图基准，与 Agent 和评估方向沾边但偏 3D 空间

hf.title: Spectral-Spatial Interpretation
hf.abstract: Post-hoc image explanations usually show where a model looks using spatial heatmaps or indicate which channels matter using global channel scores. These separate views are limiting for multispectral data because channel relevance is often spatially localized and physically meaningful. We introduce Spectral-Spatial Interpretation (SSI), a full-grid attribution method over position-channel players (g,c). For each spatial position, SSI fixes the observed surrounding context, defines a conditional game over the channels at that position, and applies the Shapley value to this local game. The result is a full spectral-spatial attribution matrix rather than a single heatmap or a global channel ranking. SSI has a clear local interpretation. It satisfies Shapley fairness within each position, and aggregating its channel attributions exactly recovers the position-level contextual contrast obtained by replacing that position with the baseline. SSI also differs from context-averaged Owen-style hierarchical accounting, which uses the same position-channel grouping but averages over external spatial coalitions. On HLS Burn Scar, SSI outperforms an MC-Owen estimator across retained attribution metrics while using only about 6% of its evaluation budget. Across CUB-200, EuroSAT, and HLS Burn Scar under both per-channel mean and zero baselines, SSI achieves the best joint deletion and insertion AUC over dense, flat, and rank-1 baselines, yields the strongest spectral hit rates and channel deletion, and leads spatial localization on both annotated datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/AtheavenMa/Spectral-Spatial-Interpretation.
hf.titleZh: 光谱-空间解释（SSI）
hf.summaryZh: 多光谱图像的事后解释中，空间热图与全局通道打分彼此割裂，而通道重要性往往在空间上局部化且具物理含义。SSI 把归因对象扩展为「位置-通道」二元组(g,c):在每个空间位置固定周围上下文，对该位置的各通道构造条件博弈并计算 Shapley 值，输出完整的谱-空归因矩阵，而非单一热图或全局通道排序。该方法在位置内满足 Shapley 公平性，通道归因聚合可精确还原将该位置替换为基线所得的上下文对比，并区别于对空间联盟取平均的 Owen 式分层记账。在 HLS Burn Scar 上以约 6% 的评估预算即超过 MC-Owen;在 CUB-200、EuroSAT、HLS Burn Scar 上，deletion/insertion 联合 AUC、光谱命中率与通道删除、空间定位均优于稠密、flat 与 rank-1 基线。
hf.reason: 多光谱图像归因方法，与 LLM 方向无交集，仅方法学略沾边

hf.title: Cache Engineering for Agents
hf.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage become the dominant cost. Trajectories can also exceed the LLM's maximum context length, requiring control over active cache growth. Prior work uses context engineering to reduce cache size by trimming or summarizing history. However, modifying the trajectory prefix invalidates subsequent cached states and triggers costly re-prefilling of retained context. Task accuracy can also suffer when too little context is retained to limit re-prefill costs. We propose cache engineering as a new scheme. It allows agents to directly control their active KV cache without modifying the trajectory or re-prefilling retained context. Specifically, agents can proactively use drop to exclude selected cache from future attention and repos to adjust retained keys' position encodings. We formalize these cache operations and identify history dependence as a serving challenge: identical token sequences can yield different cache states under different cache operation sequences, making prefix matching insufficient for correct cache reuse. Thus, we co-design the AKV serving engine. It provides a stateless interface compatible with existing serving APIs, while internally managing stateful cache reuse, eviction, and restoration. Experiments show that a tool-response rolling-drop cache policy improves average benchmark scores by 1.7 points and reduces average cost by 27.7%, compared with conventional threshold-triggered summarization. With AKV, it achieves up to 1.2x the output throughput and a 1.5x speedup in P95 request latency. Recursive self-improvement of cache policies further reduces cost by 7.1% over expert design. Our code is at https://github.com/thu-nics/AKV.
hf.titleZh: 面向 Agent 的缓存工程
hf.summaryZh: 长轨迹 Agent 的 KV cache I/O 与存储已成主要开销，而裁剪或摘要历史会破坏前缀、触发昂贵的重新 prefill，并可能损失任务准确率。该工作提出 cache engineering：Agent 主动用 drop 把选定缓存排除出后续注意力、用 repos 调整保留 key 的位置编码，从而在不改轨迹、不重算的前提下直接控制活跃缓存；同时指出相同 token 序列在不同缓存操作序列下状态不同所带来的历史依赖问题，并设计 AKV 服务引擎，对外提供无状态接口、内部管理带状态的复用、驱逐与恢复。实验显示工具响应滚动 drop 策略比阈值触发摘要平均提升 1.7 分、降低成本 27.7%，AKV 输出吞吐最高 1.2 倍、P95 延迟加速 1.5 倍，缓存策略的递归自我改进再降本 7.1%。
hf.reason: Agent KV cache 操作与 serving 引擎协同设计，命中 Agent 与系统效率方向

hf.title: Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents
hf.abstract: A login screen that appears after a tap on Sign in is expected; the same screen after a tap on View order is an attack. For GUI agents, safety is therefore a property of the transition rather than of the screen, and a monitor that inspects only screens can be defeated by reusing a legitimate one. Judging a transition requires an expectation of what should have followed the action. Existing GUI world models provide one, but they output it as text, code, or images, so checking it against the observed screen requires a second model to judge the two. We argue that a world model meant for verification should instead predict in the space in which observations are encoded, and present LGWM, a decoder-free, action-conditioned world model that predicts the representation of the next screen directly, trained without semantic annotation on 1.85M real GUI transitions. Verification reduces to a vector comparison, and the same signal reveals whether a mismatch is harmful. We evaluate on RSWT-BENCH, a diagnostic where each credential screen appears under both a legitimate and a hijacked transition, so detectors that see only the screen are at chance by construction. The training-free score reaches 0.987 AUC at 17 ms per decision, on par with the strongest closed-source VLMs and about ten AUC points above generative GUI world models at over three orders of magnitude lower latency. The residual direction reaches 0.953 AUC at separating harmful from benign violations, where prompted VLMs are near chance. Further analyses show that the prediction is a usable future state rather than an anomaly score. World models have mostly served as simulators or planners; our results point to a third role, verification, for which predicting in representation space is the natural design.
hf.titleZh: 正确的界面，错误的转移：世界模型作为 GUI Agent 的验证器
hf.summaryZh: GUI Agent 的安全性不能只看屏幕内容：登录页出现在点击「Sign in」之后属正常，出现在点击「View order」之后则是攻击，因此需要判断「转移」是否符合预期。为此提出 LGWM——无解码器、以动作为条件的世界模型，直接在观测编码空间中预测下一屏表征，在 185 万条真实 GUI 转移上以无语义标注方式训练；验证由此退化为向量比较，残差方向还能区分有害与良性违规。在 RSWT-BENCH 上，免训练打分达到 0.987 AUC、单次判定 17 ms，与最强闭源 VLM 持平，比生成式 GUI 世界模型高约 10 个 AUC 点且延迟低三个数量级以上；有害与良性违规的区分达 0.953 AUC，而提示式 VLM 接近随机。这表明世界模型除模拟器与规划器外还有第三种角色：验证。
hf.reason: GUI Agent 安全与表征空间世界模型验证，方法新颖，命中 Agent 方向

hf.title: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
hf.abstract: Agent learning is shifting from learning from human data toward learning through interaction with the world. However, scaling such learning directly in real-world computer systems is challenging and can introduce substantial security risks. We therefore propose Agent World Model in the Wild (WildAWM), a scalable pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments and tasks for training general computer-use agents (CUAs). Whereas existing approaches typically specialize in a single agent interaction interface, we construct executable environments that jointly support graphical user interfaces, model context protocol services, and command-line interfaces, allowing agents to flexibly combine visual interaction, tool use, and code execution. WildAWM is entirely powered by open-source models, demonstrating that high-quality computer-use environments can be generated without proprietary frontier models. Beyond environments, we address three recurring challenges in task synthesis: ensuring solvability, maintaining sufficient difficulty, and producing reliable verifiers, by introducing execution-based quality gates that combine heterogeneous agent rollouts, cross-judge consistency checks, and counterfactual probes of judgment robustness. The resulting pipeline synthesizes 341 long-horizon environment-task pairs that can require over 100 agent steps to solve and remain challenging even for frontier models, with GPT-6-Astra solving only 60% of them. We train two Qwen models of different sizes exclusively in these synthetic worlds. Both models achieve substantial gains across 8 out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents, demonstrating that learning in WildAWM's synthesized worlds generalizes broadly to unseen computer-use tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM.
hf.titleZh: 野外智能体世界模型：计算机使用智能体环境合成
hf.summaryZh: 针对在真实计算机系统中训练计算机使用智能体（CUA）易产生安全风险且难以规模化的问题，提出可扩展的合成环境与任务流水线 WildAWM，同时支持图形界面、模型上下文协议服务与命令行三类交互接口，使智能体能组合视觉操作、工具调用与代码执行。该流水线全部由开源模型驱动，并用异构智能体 rollout、交叉评判一致性检查与反事实探针等执行式质量门控，保证任务可解、难度充分且验证器可靠。最终合成 341 个长程环境—任务对，部分任务需逾 100 步，前沿模型 GPT-6-Astra 仅解出 60%。两个不同规模 Qwen 模型仅在这些合成世界中训练，即在 web、claw 与 computer-use 等 8 个分布外基准上取得显著提升，说明合成环境中的学习可广泛泛化到未见过的计算机使用任务。
hf.reason: 面向 CUA 的环境合成与 Agentic RL，直接命中 Agent 方向

hf.title: Scaling in Games: Continued Pre-Training For Embodied Agents In Diverse Virtual Worlds
hf.abstract: Scaling data, diversity and model capacity has improved embodied learning in physical environments, where diverse experiences remain grounded in shared physical laws. Whether these gains extend to virtual worlds with different visual styles, dynamics, controls, and objectives remains unclear. We investigate this question through a controlled study of continued pre-training (CPT) across three axes: data volume, diversity, and model size. Our 120 training configurations span four model sizes from 0.8B to 27B, six data budgets from 50 to 1,600 hours, and five mixtures ranging from Minecraft-only data to diverse multi-world corpora. We assess performance and generalization using three-level validation losses and gameplay benchmarks from in-corpus worlds to unseen worlds. Our results show: (1) more data improves in-corpus performance, diversity improves transfer to related worlds with limited gains in distant worlds, and model size improves data efficiency but generalizes worse to distant worlds under single-world training; (2) we observe an early interface phase with broad cross-world benefits and a later world phase with gains narrowed to in-corpus and related worlds, and fit an empirical scaling law relating validation loss to data volume, diversity and model size; and (3) our models are competitive with Minecraft specialists and frontier models in 3D worlds, and perform best in real-time settings. However, the limits of imitation and persistent gaps in distant worlds suggest that building generalist embodied agents requires richer training stages beyond continued pre-training.
hf.titleZh: 游戏中的扩展：面向具身智能体在多样虚拟世界中的持续预训练
hf.summaryZh: 研究持续预训练能否让具身智能体跨视觉风格、动力学与控制方式各异的虚拟世界迁移。用 120 组配置系统扫描 0.8B–27B 四个模型规模、50–1600 小时六档数据预算与五种数据混合（从纯 Minecraft 到多世界语料），以三级验证损失和游戏基准衡量泛化。结果显示：数据量提升语料内表现，多样性主要惠及相近世界、对远域收益有限，单世界训练下大模型数据效率更高但远域泛化更差；训练呈现早期「接口阶段」与后期「世界阶段」，并拟合出含数据量、多样性与模型规模的经验 scaling law。模型在 3D 世界中与 Minecraft 专家模型及前沿模型相当，实时场景最优。
hf.reason: 有 scaling law 与预训练分析，但主体是具身虚拟世界智能体，属低分方向

hf.title: PrismaCoder: Pushing the Boundaries of Open Multimodal Code Intelligence through Decomposed Rubric Synthesis
hf.abstract: Multimodal code intelligence connects the symbolic world of programs with the visual world their execution creates. Interest in this capability is burgeoning, as models are increasingly asked to produce charts, webpages, animations, and semi-structured documents. Recently, proprietary models have pushed far ahead, producing interactive artifacts even from a text description or a screenshot alone. Yet their data and training remain closed, and open progress is held back by the quantity and quality of available data and by the pipelines and methods for producing it. Quality is the harder of the two, since a sample must be correct as a program, well built, and above all visually right once rendered. No existing signal covers all three. Execution often returns just a pass or fail, code similarity does not map to the visual output, and task-specific verifiers do not generalize. To push open progress further, we start from the data side with PrismaForge, a hierarchical data pipeline centered on a synthesized rubric that decomposes these factors into checkable criteria. The same rubric serves as both filter and reward: it curates the supervised corpus, then drives reinforcement learning on visual-coding tasks. Leveraging PrismaForge for data synthesis and filtering, we build PrismaCoder-2M, the most diverse open dataset for multimodal code intelligence and the largest to date. On the model side, we train PrismaCoder-9B and PrismaCoder-35B on this data and release both. They lead the open state of the art by a wide margin and rival leading proprietary systems. Our analyses further show that the proposed rubric-based pipeline improves multimodal coding performance across model backbones. We release our code and data at https://qiushisun.github.io/PrismaCoder-Home/.
hf.titleZh: PrismaCoder:通过分解式评分标准合成拓展开放多模态代码智能的边界
hf.summaryZh: 多模态代码智能要求模型生成的图表、网页与动画在渲染后视觉正确，但执行反馈只给通过或失败、代码相似度与视觉输出不对应、专用验证器难以泛化，现有信号无法同时覆盖程序正确、构建质量与视觉正确三个维度。PrismaForge 将这些因素分解为可核查的评分标准(rubric)，同一套 rubric 既作数据过滤器又作强化学习奖励，据此构建出 2M 规模的开源数据集 PrismaCoder-2M，并训练并开源 PrismaCoder-9B 与 PrismaCoder-35B。两个模型大幅领先开源 SOTA 并逼近领先闭源系统，分析显示该 rubric 流程在不同骨干网络上均带来稳定增益。
hf.reason: 多模态代码数据合成加rubric奖励RL，系统性强且开源

hf.title: Socratic Skill Learning: Interleaving Teaching and Practice for Transferable Agent Skills
hf.abstract: Agent Skills improve LLM agents by making task knowledge reusable across sessions. Learning transferable Skills requires evidence about a procedure and its conditions of use, which a successful task attempt can leave untested. We introduce Socratic Skill Learning (SSL), which interleaves expert teaching with Student practice. An Educator guides investigation while the Student remains the sole environment operator and Skill author, able to question, test, and adapt advice. To test reuse beyond the learning task, we construct SkillTransferBench, with 35 task families and 408 executable cases, pairing public variation specifications with held-out evaluation in fresh solver sessions. On the main 22-family, 155-case cohort, Fixed-Window SSL reaches 0.801 utility, versus 0.723 without a Skill, 0.761 for adapted Trace2Skill (trajectory distillation), and 0.751 for adapted SKILL-KD (contrastive distillation). Across three model pairs on shared families, interleaved guidance outperforms expert authoring and post-hoc teaching. Process analysis links guidance to Student writing and package revision; a case study shows the Student testing and refining a proposed procedure for later reuse. As demand for new lessons falls, the cost of fixed-window review grows. Issue-Guided SSL tracks unresolved questions across Skill revisions to select and focus review, reaching 0.805 utility with 61.7% fewer Educator tokens and 16.9% fewer total acquisition tokens than Fixed-Window SSL on the main cohort.
hf.titleZh: 苏格拉底式技能学习：交织教学与实践以培养可迁移的Agent技能
hf.summaryZh: 针对Agent技能学习中成功轨迹未必能检验出程序适用条件的问题，提出Socratic Skill Learning（SSL），让Educator只引导探究、Student始终是唯一的环境操作者与技能作者，可质疑、测试并改写建议。构建SkillTransferBench（35个任务族、408个可执行用例），以公开变体规格配合新会话中的留出评测检验技能复用。在主队列22族155例上，Fixed-Window SSL效用达0.801，无技能为0.723，Trace2Skill为0.761，SKILL-KD为0.751；Issue-Guided SSL进一步以0.805效用实现Educator token减少61.7%、总获取token减少16.9%。
hf.reason: Agent技能学习与自进化，方法清晰且有基准与量化收益

hf.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Compositionality
hf.abstract: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external knowledge. Modern pipelines combine embedding, chunking, retrieval, reranking, query augmentation, context compression, and agentic verification, yet these techniques are typically evaluated one at a time. It remains unclear whether their isolated gains survive composition, whether retrieval quality and answer faithfulness favor the same design choices, and whether conclusions from small corpora hold at large scale. We pre-declare three hypotheses and introduce LASAGNA, an open-source framework for controlled RAG evaluation. We test 450 configurations across eight benchmarks and corpora ranging from 5K to 200K documents. Three findings emerge. First, individually strong techniques from different phases of a RAG pipeline do not necessarily compose: three retrieval techniques predict a +47% combined improvement but deliver only +17% when used together. Second, component gains stack differently for retrieval and faithfulness, and optimizing one can hurt the other. Third, the best composition changes as the corpus grows: the combination that wins on a small corpus may not remain best at large scale. These findings show that gains measured in isolation are not reliable predictors of realistic performance, and that new RAG techniques should be tested with the full surrounding stack. We call on researchers to do so and supply LASAGNA to simplify these experiments.
hf.titleZh: 检索增强生成的组合性
hf.summaryZh: 现代 RAG 流水线会叠加嵌入、分块、检索、重排、查询扩展、上下文压缩与 agentic 验证等技术，但通常被逐项单独评测。该工作预注册三个假设并开源 LASAGNA 框架，在 8 个基准、5K 至 200K 文档规模上运行 450 种配置做受控评测。结果显示:三项检索技术单独看可预测 +47% 的合计增益，组合使用后实际只兑现 +17%;检索质量与答案忠实度偏好的组件选择并不一致，优化其一会损害另一个;最优组合随语料增大而改变，小语料上的赢家在大规模下未必仍最好。这表明孤立测得的增益无法可靠预测真实表现，新 RAG 技术需在完整技术栈中验证。
hf.reason: RAG 全流水线受控评测，揭示组件组合失效，方法学扎实

hf.title: TraceForge: Distilling with Your Own Thinking
hf.abstract: Using an LLM to generate training data for another is among the most general ways to train one, and it remains common practice. Some frontier teams have closed that route for their own models: what comes back is an answer, or a short summary, without the detailed reasoning trace behind it. That is a little ironic: they were themselves built on distilling human knowledge, and distilling an open-source model is still entirely routine; the restriction applies to their own outputs alone. Recent work recovers the hidden reasoning by replaying encrypted blocks across models. It somehow works, but it breaks the providers' terms of service, so it is not something a product can be built on long-term. We built the alternative. We take the context and the teacher's answer as input, and generate the reasoning trace ourselves, in the style of the student's own model family. Training is two-stage, supervised and then adversarial: a generator learns to regenerate the family's own reasoning traces from their context and answer, and a critic learns how real a reasoning trace looks. Applied to a teacher's answer, the generator writes one in the family's style. An independent judge rates how likely traces are to be genuine on a scale from 0 to 1: ours average 0.68, real traces 0.66, and traces selected by the critic from four candidates 0.82. These are authenticity scores, not correctness rates. We test the idea on five benchmarks with everything else held fixed. On general tasks the five training corpora are about the same; on coding, the generated reasoning beats Fable 5's own thinking content. With the same 5,000 questions and the same teacher answers, HumanEval+ improves by 3.7 points and MBPP+ by 7.1 at the final checkpoint, and the MBPP+ lead holds at every checkpoint. We suspect that reasoning written in the student's family style is easier for it to learn from.
hf.titleZh: TraceForge:用自己的思考做蒸馏
hf.summaryZh: 针对前沿模型 API 只返回答案或摘要、不暴露推理链、而重放加密块又违反服务条款的问题，提出在本地生成教师答案对应推理轨迹的替代方案:以上下文与教师答案为输入，两阶段训练(先监督、后对抗)，生成器学写学生模型家族风格的推理链，判别器学辨别真伪。独立评审给出真实性评分 0–1，生成轨迹平均 0.68、真实轨迹 0.66、从四候选中由判别器挑选的达 0.82。五个基准上其余条件固定，通用任务上五个训练语料表现相近，代码任务上生成推理优于 Fable 5 自带思考内容，同等 5000 题与教师答案下 HumanEval+ 提升 3.7 分、MBPP+ 提升 7.1 分，MBPP+ 优势在各 checkpoint 均保持。
hf.reason: 蒸馏教师答案的推理轨迹，契合后训练与数据合成方向

hf.title: AgenticRoboRL: Bringing Coding-Agent Post-Training to Agentic Robotics
hf.abstract: Agentic robotics systems combine planners with robot harnesses to perform complex manipulation tasks. Recent work improves these systems through better harnesses and external memory, but relies on powerful closed-source models as planners and does not improve the planners' own capabilities. In contrast, coding agents have improved substantially by post-training the model itself. We therefore investigate whether post-training can also improve robot planners. However, applying it across robot harnesses requires accommodating different execution mechanisms, including VLA skill invocation and control-code generation. To this end, we introduce AgenticRoboRL, a framework for post-training robot planners across different harnesses. The training recipe combines supervised fine-tuning with multi-turn reinforcement learning. To accommodate different execution mechanisms, harness-specific adapters connect recorded planner interactions with task outcomes, enabling a common RL training pipeline while keeping execution components fixed. On LIBERO-PRO, AgenticRoboRL raises the success rate of a 9B-parameter planner from 18.1% to 71.0% without external memory, approaching the 72.1% achieved by Codex (GPT-5.5) with external memory. These results demonstrate post-training as an effective approach for improving robot planners. We will release the framework and trained planner checkpoints.
hf.titleZh: AgenticRoboRL：把编码智能体后训练引入具身机器人智能体
hf.summaryZh: 现有机器人智能体系统靠改进 harness 与外部记忆提升表现，但规划器仍依赖强闭源模型，自身能力未被训练。AgenticRoboRL 把编码智能体的后训练范式迁移到机器人规划器：以监督微调加多轮强化学习为训练配方，并用与 harness 绑定的适配器把规划器交互记录与任务结果对应起来，从而在 VLA 技能调用、控制代码生成等不同执行机制下共用同一套 RL 流程，执行组件保持冻结。在 LIBERO-PRO 上，9B 规划器成功率从 18.1% 提升到 71.0%（无外部记忆），接近 Codex（GPT-5.5）配外部记忆的 72.1%。结果表明后训练是提升机器人规划器能力的有效路径，框架与检查点将开源。
hf.reason: 多轮 RL 后训练方法有价值，但落在具身机器人低分方向

hf.title: CulturalRiddles: A Multicultural Benchmark of Riddles
hf.abstract: As LLMs expand their language coverage, evaluating how well they understand and represent diverse cultures becomes increasingly important. However, many benchmarks remain English-centric, with limited cultural coverage and a focus on factual knowledge over its application in real-world cultural contexts. We propose CulturalRiddles, a benchmark of original, culturally grounded riddles created entirely by humans through a participatory community effort, spanning 62 cultures (45 countries, 51 languages). These riddles are deeply rooted in their respective cultures and require abductive and compositional reasoning, alongside detailed factual and social knowledge, language skills, and an understanding of culturally specific associations. We benchmark 28 LLM configurations using both automatic and large-scale human evaluation. Even frontier models achieve at most 22% accuracy in some communities. We publicly release all artifacts alongside an open contribution process to expand the benchmark's linguistic and cultural coverage.
hf.titleZh: CulturalRiddles：多文化谜语基准
hf.summaryZh: 现有文化评测基准多以英语为中心、侧重事实知识，难以反映模型在真实文化语境中的理解与应用能力。构建CulturalRiddles：覆盖62种文化（45个国家、51种语言）、由社区成员人工原创的文化谜语，解题需溯因与组合推理、事实与社会知识、语言技能及文化特定联想。对28个LLM配置开展自动评测与大规模人工评测，前沿模型在部分社区准确率最高仅22%。全部产物公开并开放贡献流程，可用于扩展语言与文化覆盖的模型文化能力评测。
hf.reason: 多语言文化评测基准，属评测与方法学方向，但为纯benchmark发布

hf.title: Memory-Centric Continual Learning for AI Agents
hf.abstract: Autonomous agents powered by foundation models can reason, plan, and use tools, but their fixed weights and context limits hinder sustained learning from experience over long-term deployment. While external memory systems attempt to bridge this gap, they mostly act as passive retrieval caches, evaluated primarily by whether they can recall stored facts or past interactions. Whether memory can drive genuine continual learning remains an open question. In this paper, we introduce Memory-Centric Continual Learning (MCCL), arguing that memory should be judged by whether it improves future actions, not merely what it retrieves. MCCL has three main parts. First, a three-axis taxonomy organizes memory by where state is stored (substrates), what form it takes (assets), and how it is managed (policies). This defines a two-loop lifecycle that updates memory state in an inner loop while refining management policies in an outer loop based on task feedback. Second, an evaluation protocol measures retention under interference, adaptation to change, and task transfer to isolate genuine behavioral gains from simple context expansion. Third, a memory scaling framework models how agent performance scales with experience, storage capacity, and compute budgets across non-parametric and parametric memory. Together, these components reframe agent memory from passive lookup to continuous learning, offering a principled route toward self-improving autonomous agents.
hf.titleZh: 以记忆为中心的AI Agent持续学习
hf.summaryZh: 针对基础模型驱动的智能体权重固定、上下文受限、难以从长期部署经验中持续学习的问题，提出以记忆为中心的持续学习框架（MCCL），主张记忆应以是否改善未来行动而非检索命中来评判。框架含三部分：按存储载体、记忆形态、管理策略三轴组织记忆，并给出内环更新记忆状态、外环依据任务反馈优化管理策略的双层生命周期；一套衡量干扰下保持、变化适应与任务迁移的评测协议，用于分离真实行为增益与单纯上下文扩张；以及刻画非参数化与参数化记忆下性能随经验、存储容量与算力预算扩展的建模框架。该工作把智能体记忆从被动查找重新定位为持续学习，为自我改进型智能体提供设计基线。
hf.reason: Agent记忆与持续学习框架，命中自我改进方向，但缺实证

hf.title: ALPS: Visual State Encoders for World Models
hf.abstract: World models turn visual representations into predictions and actions. We argue that their visual foundation should combine physical-state information, native language alignment, and pixel reconstruction, so that a single representation can support prediction, instruction, and inspection. However, existing encoders typically specialize in only one or two of these capabilities; we therefore introduce ALPS, a pretrained visual state encoder that unifies all three in a single set of patch tokens. Using only still images and text, we pretrain a ViT-B/16 from scratch with language, reconstruction, and spatial correspondence objectives, and then refine it via cross-view self-distillation. In a unified evaluation across fifteen public encoders, ALPS achieves the lowest aggregate LIBERO state-probe error among ViT-B models (matching the 3.5x larger V-JEPA 2-L) while maintaining strong language alignment and accurate pixel reconstruction. Downstream, frozen ALPS tokens reach the highest mean policy success on LIBERO (85.5%) when paired with our native text tower, match or exceed leading encoders on world-model planning across PushT, Wall, and Granular, and allow predicted future tokens to be decoded directly into pixels for visual inspection. We hope this work helps establish visual pretraining as a shared foundation for understanding, prediction, and action in world models.
hf.titleZh: ALPS:面向世界模型的视觉状态编码器
hf.summaryZh: 现有视觉编码器通常只覆盖物理状态、语言对齐、像素重建中的一两种能力，难以同时支撑预测、指令跟随与可视化检查。ALPS 用纯静态图像与文本从零预训练 ViT-B/16，联合语言、重建与空间对应目标，再用跨视角自蒸馏细化，使同一组 patch token 兼具三种性质。在十五个公开编码器的统一评测中，其 LIBERO 状态探针误差为 ViT-B 级最低，与 3.5 倍大的 V-JEPA 2-L 相当，同时保持较强语言对齐与像素重建精度;冻结特征在 LIBERO 上取得 85.5% 平均策略成功率，在 PushT、Wall、Granular 的世界模型规划中不弱于领先编码器，且预测的未来 token 可直接解码为像素。
hf.reason: 世界模型视觉编码服务于机器人控制，属具身方向，相关度有限

hf.title: DeLoop: Repeated Actions as Self-Supervision for Long-Horizon Agents
hf.abstract: Language-model agents that run long tasks often redo work they have already done: they re-issue a tool call they made earlier and get back exactly the same observation, a step that adds no new information. We identify this failure as a loop. Loops appear natively in Qwen, Llama, and Gemini agents and become far more common once the agent's history is compressed to fit its context window. To reduce these loops, we propose DeLoop, a self-supervised training method. DeLoop builds on a simple observation: the agent's own rollout can provide the supervision needed to learn from its loops. We use a looping action as a negative example and the first later non-looping action in the same rollout as a positive example. DeLoop learns from these pairs through direct preference optimization and does not require task rewards, gold answers, or LLM judges. On CodeGym under compression, DeLoop reduces the share of Qwen3-8B tasks containing loops from 57.3% to 6.1%. It also uses about one third as many steps per task, with similar task success. On Qwen3-32B, DeLoop reduces loops and steps while raising task success from 37.7% to 44.8%.
hf.titleZh: DeLoop：将重复动作作为长程Agent的自监督信号
hf.summaryZh: 长任务中语言模型Agent常重复已执行过的工具调用，取回相同观察，纯属无效步骤；上下文压缩后此现象更严重。DeLoop 利用Agent自身rollout构造偏好对：把循环动作作负例，同轨迹中其后首个非循环动作作正例，用DPO自监督训练，无需任务奖励、标准答案或LLM评审。在CodeGym压缩设置下，Qwen3-8B出现循环的任务占比从57.3%降至6.1%，每任务步数约为原来三分之一且成功率相当；Qwen3-32B上循环与步数同时下降，成功率从37.7%升至44.8%。
hf.reason: Agent长程循环的自监督DPO修复，直接命中Agent与后训练方向

hf.title: Real In, Real Out: What If We Only Use Real Data for Scene Text Editing?
hf.abstract: Aiming to modify textual content while preserving the original style, Scene Text Editing (STE) has significant practical value in many applications. STE typically requires paired images before and after editing for training. However, recent approaches rely heavily on synthetic paired data and complex disentanglement strategies. They struggle to faithfully capture the diversity and complexity of natural scenes, often producing artifacts or hallucinations. In this work, we challenge the common practice and investigate whether STE can be driven by turning each real sample into its own paired supervision. Concretely, we explore multiple ways to disrupt the original image (e.g., Crop, Shuffle, Mask) to construct self-paired training data, and build a strong baseline (TextRIRO}) upon a conditional diffusion architecture. Our experiments show that combining character-column shuffling with image cropping (Shuffle&Crop) effectively destroys text semantics while preserving key style cues, enabling the model to learn editing behaviors directly from the real text image. With this concise yet real-oriented design, TextRIRO achieves promising performance in both accuracy and visual realism across real-world benchmarks, substantially mitigating the synthetic-to-real domain gap. Furthermore, we leverage TextRIRO to build TextRIRO-3M, a large-scale realistic dataset for long-text recognition by concatenating edited and original images. Experimental results show that training recognition models with TextRIRO-3M significantly improves recognition accuracy, demonstrating that TextRIRO provides highly useful training resources for downstream tasks. Overall, TextRIRO lifts STE to realistic, reliable, and widely applicable new levels. Code is available at https://github.com/YesianRohn/TextRIRO.
hf.titleZh: 真实输入，真实输出：如果场景文本编辑只用真实数据会怎样？
hf.summaryZh: 场景文本编辑需要成对的编辑前后图像，现有方法依赖合成配对数据和复杂的解耦策略，结果常出现伪影与幻觉。该工作改用自配对监督：把每张真实图通过字符列打乱、裁剪、遮挡等方式破坏，构造配对训练信号，并基于条件扩散架构建立基线 TextRIRO，其中「打乱+裁剪」能在破坏文本语义的同时保留风格线索。在真实基准上，该方法在准确率与视觉真实感上表现良好，明显缓解了合成到真实的域差距；作者还用其拼接编辑图与原始图，构建了 3M 规模的长文本识别数据集 TextRIRO-3M，训练识别模型可显著提升准确率。
hf.reason: 扩散式场景文本图像编辑，属视觉生成低分方向，仅与文本识别数据沾边

hf.title: PACE: Periodic and Channel-Aligned Encoding of Four-Bit Recurrent States
hf.abstract: Linear-attention language models keep their context in a recurrent state of fixed size, where an inference system stores one copy of this state for every sequence it decodes at the same time. Storing the state at lower precision therefore lets more sequences share an accelerator. Existing state quantizers round the state after every generated token and report that four bits lose accuracy unless the bit width is raised or the model is fine-tuned.\par We introduce PACE, a post-hoc four-bit state quantizer. PACE rounds the state only once every few generated tokens, as chunked kernels already do once per chunk during prefill, and keeps the tokens generated in between in a small buffer. Rounding less often reduces the error that accumulates in the state. Additionally, we find that the large entries of the gated-delta state gather in columns, because some channels of the update written at each token remain large across many tokens. PACE therefore shares each quantization scale within one column. It also keeps the heads that retain rounding error longest at eight bits. On four hybrid models from 4B to 35B parameters, PACE with mixed four- and eight-bit heads is competitive with eight-bit DAMP on the three larger models at about two thirds of its memory, PACE with four-bit heads throughout scores higher than Q-Mamba at equal memory, and rounding every few tokens preserves the decoding speedup of the buffer.
hf.titleZh: PACE:四位循环状态的周期性通道对齐编码
hf.summaryZh: 线性注意力语言模型为每条并发解码序列保存一份固定大小的循环状态，降低其存储精度可让更多序列共享同一块加速器;现有量化器每生成一个 token 就舍入一次状态，导致四位精度下不微调或提高位宽便掉点。PACE 改为每隔若干 token 才舍入一次，中间生成的 token 暂存于小缓冲，从而减少状态中的累积误差;同时发现门控 delta 状态的大值集中在固定列上，于是让同一列共享量化 scale，并把舍入误差消退最慢的 head 保留为八位。在四个 4B–35B 混合模型上，四/八位混合 head 的 PACE 在三个较大模型上以约三分之二显存达到与八位 DAMP 相当的效果，全四位 head 在同等显存下优于 Q-Mamba，且周期性舍入未损失缓冲带来的解码加速。
hf.reason: 线性注意力循环状态量化，命中推理效率方向，工作扎实

hf.title: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
hf.abstract: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.
hf.titleZh: 多模态具身智能体：从计算机使用到机器人使用的统一能力视角
hf.summaryZh: 多模态智能体从计算机使用走向机器人使用时，任务推理需要与物理动作耦合，可逆空间收窄、可预先固定的选择变少。提出 PAPAV 能力框架，按功能而非架构划分为五项能力：感知当前状态、预判动作效果、规划可行路径、通过接口或本体执行、验证结果；并据此对比多模态智能体与机器人系统。梳理 64 个基准发现评测几乎集中在「执行」，仅 5 个考察「预判」、3 个考察「验证」，后两者基本被任务成功率掩盖。该框架为设计可靠物理智能体、按五项能力而非单看成功率衡量进展提供共同参照。
hf.reason: 以具身机器人为核心，只借 Agent 能力框架轻微涉及关注方向

hf.title: Building AI Research Teams for Autonomous Discovery of Linear Attention Architectures
hf.abstract: Autonomous agents can increasingly propose ideas, modify code, and run experiments, creating an opportunity to accelerate scientific discovery using teams of collaborative AI researchers. To escape local minima in the discovery, we propose to encourage orthogonal exploration by constructing the team using agents with varying expertise. However, realizing this design requires more than diverse backgrounds. When experiments are costly, a team can test only a limited number of ideas, thereby creating the need to balance exploration and exploitation when selecting a subset of researchers to propose and execute new experiments. Furthermore, each result should shape what the team tries next. We therefore ask how AI researchers with different scientific backgrounds can build on one another's findings and sustain progress under a limited experimental budget. To address these challenges, we build a team of persistent AI researchers, each grounded in a different discipline, who keep private research histories, share experimental evidence, and receive research opportunities through adaptive allocation. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this design by deploying the team to search for linear attention architectures, where it outperforms GDN2 at 1.3B scale on language modeling, common-sense reasoning, and synthetic and real-world retrieval tasks. In controlled comparisons, removing any single organizational component from our design yields markedly weaker discoveries: without disciplinary backgrounds, the search plateaus early; without private histories, researchers make less progress despite identical shared evidence; and uniform selection falls short of adaptive allocation within the same budget. These results suggest that sustained autonomous discovery depends not only on stronger agents, but also on who explores, what they remember, and how research effort is allocated.
hf.titleZh: 构建 AI 研究团队:自主发现线性注意力架构
hf.summaryZh: 为在实验预算有限时避免局部最优，把多个具有不同学科背景的持久化 AI 研究员组成团队，各自保留私有研究历史、共享实验证据，并通过自适应分配决定谁来提出与执行实验。将该团队用于搜索线性注意力架构，在 1.3B 规模的语言建模、常识推理以及合成与真实检索任务上超过 GDN2。消融显示，去掉学科背景会让搜索早期停滞，去掉私有历史会在相同共享证据下进展更慢，均匀选择不如同预算下的自适应分配。
hf.reason: AI 科研智能体团队＋线性注意力架构发现，双重命中高分方向

hf.title: Harness Scaling for Generalizable Agentic Reinforcement Learning
hf.abstract: Agent harnesses have become a central component of modern agentic systems, shaping how models use tools, manage context, and coordinate long-horizon interaction. Realizing the benefits of these harnesses depends on how effectively the underlying model can make use of them, motivating reinforcement learning directly through the harness. However, existing approaches typically train through a single fixed harness, which can lead to specialization and limited transfer across harness configurations. To address this, we introduce Harness Scaling, a new scaling dimension for agentic RL that extends training from a single harness to diverse execution configurations. Concretely, we construct a factorized harness space, select a compact training subset with balanced factorial coverage, and organize cross-harness training to combine global coverage with controlled variation for the same task. Across multiple benchmarks, model scales, and RL algorithms, Harness Scaling consistently improves generalization to unseen white-box configurations. Moreover, models trained through structured white-box variation transfer effectively to unseen external black-box harnesses, outperforming models trained through a single complex black-box harness. These results establish harness diversity as a meaningful scaling dimension for agentic RL and highlight the importance of how this diversity is organized for cross-harness generalization.
hf.titleZh: Harness Scaling：面向可泛化智能体强化学习的执行框架扩展
hf.summaryZh: 现有智能体 RL 训练通常固定单一 harness，导致模型过拟合该执行配置、跨 harness 迁移能力有限。本文将 harness 视为新的扩展维度，构建因子化 harness 空间，按平衡因子覆盖挑选紧凑训练子集，并组织跨 harness 训练，在全局覆盖与同任务受控变化之间取得平衡。在多个 benchmark、模型规模与 RL 算法上，该方法稳定提升对未见白盒配置的泛化，且经结构化白盒变化训练的模型能有效迁移到未见的外部黑盒 harness，优于用单一复杂黑盒 harness 训练的结果。这表明 harness 多样性可作为智能体 RL 的扩展维度，为 Agentic RL 的泛化训练提供了可复用的组织方式。
hf.reason: Agentic RL 与 harness 泛化，直击 Agent 后训练核心

hf.title: From VLM Planners to Robotic Agents: Self-Evolving Harnesses for History-Dependent Manipulation
hf.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve strong performance across embodied manipulation tasks by unifying visual understanding, language conditioning, and action generation. However, long-horizon tasks can involve non-Markovian dependencies: successful decisions may require retaining task progress and past interaction outcomes, while partial observability and execution errors compound over time. Existing work has begun to address these challenges by augmenting foundation-model policies with memory and by introducing hierarchical architectures that separate high-level planning from low-level execution. We organize the high-level VLM as a robotic agent through an editable harness to maintain task context and improve planning through execution experience. We instantiate this approach as SERA (Self-Evolving Robotic Agent), with a fixed VLA executor providing low-level control. The harness maintains and updates task context using observations and execution feedback to guide subsequent planning. Self-evolution uses environment rollouts to propose and evaluate harness revisions, with the selected configuration fixed before held-out testing. On RoboMME, SERA achieves 51.38% overall success with autonomous selection, compared with 44.38% without self-evolution. Our exploration suggests that agentic planning is a promising direction for history-dependent robotic manipulation.
hf.titleZh: 从 VLM 规划器到机器人智能体:面向历史依赖操作的自进化 Harness
hf.summaryZh: 长程机器人操作存在非马尔可夫依赖:任务进度与历史交互结果需要保留，部分可观测与执行误差会随时间累积。该工作把高层 VLM 规划器组织为可编辑 harness 的机器人智能体，由固定的 VLA 执行器负责底层控制，harness 依据观测与执行反馈维护并更新任务上下文，并通过环境 rollout 提出和评估 harness 修订来实现自进化。在 RoboMME 上，自主选择配置的总体成功率为 51.38%，而无自进化时为 44.38%。这提示智能体式规划是应对历史依赖操作的可探索路径。
hf.reason: VLA 机器人操作，属具身智能一刀切低分方向

hf.title: Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR Technical Report
hf.abstract: We present Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR, a family of audio-language models that builds upon its predecesor Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR with improved speech recognition and expanded capabilities in speaker-diarized transcription and general audio understanding. The family retains support for 30 languages and 16 Chinese dialects, together with instruction-controlled capabilities including historical-context conditioning, hierarchical hotword customization, and native transcription polishing. Speaker-diarized ASR produces structured outputs containing speaker labels, timestamps, and recognized text, maintaining consistent speaker labels across turns and the representation of overlapping speech. The general audio understanding capabilities cover audio-, speech-, and music-captioning, temporal grounding and sound event detection, as well as audio question answering and multiple-choice reasoning. These tasks broaden the application scope from recognizing spoken words to interpreting speakers, acoustic events, and their temporal relations. To accommodate different deployment requirements, the family includes variants for asynchronous file transcription, low-latency streaming, interactive voice input, and non-streaming recognition, with speaker-diarized transcription and general audio understanding available in certain variants. Evaluations span conventional ASR, multilingual and dialectal speech, speaker-diarized transcription, and general audio understanding, demonstrating the capabilities of the Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR family across transcription and broader audio analysis tasks.
hf.titleZh: Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR 技术报告
hf.summaryZh: 面向语音识别与音频理解，发布 Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR 系列音频语言模型，在 3.0 版基础上强化识别能力，并新增说话人分离转写与通用音频理解。模型支持 30 种语言与 16 种中文方言，提供历史上下文条件、分层热词定制与原生转写润色等指令控制能力;说话人分离转写输出带说话人标签、时间戳与文本的结构化结果，并处理跨轮说话人一致性与重叠语音。通用音频理解覆盖音频、语音、音乐描述、时间定位与声音事件检测、音频问答与多选推理。系列按部署需求分为异步文件转写、低延迟流式、交互式语音输入与非流式识别四种变体，评测覆盖常规 ASR、多语言与方言、说话人分离转写及通用音频理解。
hf.reason: 语音识别与音频理解技术报告，属低分语音应用方向

hf.title: RealMe: Immersive Volumetric Video from Minimal Captures
hf.abstract: This paper addresses the problem of creating immersive volumetric videos from sparse and low-resolution capture resources. Conventional dense multi-view reconstruction methods can produce high-quality volumetric videos, but their reliance on costly capture setups makes them impractical in real-world scenarios. Recent approaches use generative models to relax capture requirements, but still suffer from limited resolution and 4D inconsistency. To overcome these constraints, we propose RealMe, a unified framework built around a high-resolution video diffusion model that enhances limited captures into high-resolution (2K), 4D-consistent videos for volumetric video reconstruction. Specifically, RealMe constructs auxiliary data from capture videos and encodes them into latents along with layout-aware positional embeddings. The video diffusion model adapts factorized spatio-temporal attention to the multi-view capture layout, denoises these latents across viewpoints and time, and decodes them into enhanced videos to refine the 4D representation. This adaptation helps the model capture temporal dynamics and multi-view relationships, leading to more 4D-consistent generation. To reduce the data gap between generated videos and real captures, we apply a latent frequency loss that provides frequency-domain supervision in latent space. Extensive experiments on the public DNA-Rendering benchmark and our self-captured RealVV dataset demonstrate that RealMe is able to create immersive volumetric videos and outperforms state-of-the-art methods in visual fidelity and 4D consistency.
hf.titleZh: RealMe：从极简采集生成沉浸式体积视频
hf.summaryZh: 针对稀疏、低分辨率多视角采集难以重建高质量体积视频的问题，RealMe 以高分辨率视频扩散模型为核心，将采集视频构建为辅助数据并连同布局感知位置编码一起编码为 latent，采用适配多视角采集布局的分解时空注意力，跨视角与时间联合去噪，再解码为增强视频以精化 4D 表示；同时在 latent 空间引入频域损失，以缩小生成视频与真实采集之间的域差距。在 DNA-Rendering 与自建 RealVV 数据集上，方法可生成 2K 分辨率、4D 一致的体积视频，视觉保真度与 4D 一致性优于现有方法。
hf.reason: 4D 体积视频重建依赖扩散模型，属视觉生成与重建方向

hf.title: Agentic World Action Models
hf.abstract: Recent world action models provide visual foresight and future prediction for robot manipulation, but lack explicit mechanisms for compositional skill reuse. Agentic robotics combines code-based planning and reasoning with reusable skills, but often lacks predictive grounding in physical dynamics. We introduce AW-0, an agentic world action model framework that integrates code-based planning with joint video and action prediction. We jointly model code, future video, and robot actions as three coupled generative streams within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. Within this architecture a code expert generates parameterized skill routines and control logic while video and action experts generate future visual states and low-level motor commands. Code serves two complementary roles: it structures multi-step prediction and control within the world model and represents skills as reusable programs for subsequent agentic execution. We further introduce an automated curation pipeline that labels robot and human video trajectories with aligned programs and consolidates recurring routines into reusable skill libraries. Evaluations on RoboTwin 2.0 and physical bimanual manipulation tasks show improved task performance over VLA and WAM baselines, alongside gains in language following, semantic reasoning and robustness, demonstrating that agentic code enables connection between planning, prediction and execution within WAMs.
hf.titleZh: Agentic World Action Models
hf.summaryZh: 针对机器人操作的世界动作模型缺少可组合技能复用、而代码式智能体规划又缺少物理动态预测的问题，AW-0 把代码、未来视频与机器人动作建模为统一的 mixture-of-transformers 中三条耦合生成流：代码专家产出参数化技能例程与控制逻辑，视频与动作专家分别生成未来视觉状态与底层运动指令；代码既组织多步预测控制，也把技能表示为可复用程序。配套自动化数据流程为机器人与人类视频轨迹标注对齐程序，并将重复例程沉淀为技能库。在 RoboTwin 2.0 与真实双臂操作任务上优于 VLA 与 WAM 基线，并在语言跟随、语义推理与鲁棒性上有提升。
hf.reason: 机器人操作 VLA／世界动作模型，属具身智能低分方向

hf.title: CompactSplat: Spatially Adaptive Gaussian Distribution for Feedforward Scene Reconstruction
hf.abstract: Reconstructing 3D scenes from sparse views without per-scene optimization remains highly challenging, especially for recovering accurate geometry and fine textures. While recent feedforward approaches leverage generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for scene generation, they typically assign one or multiple Gaussians to each pixel. Such uniform allocation not only produces highly redundant representations by wasting primitives in homogeneous areas, but also fails to exploit the inherent geometric priors of planar surfaces, often resulting in sub-optimal structural modeling. To address these limitations, we present CompactSplat, a novel feedforward framework that enables a content-aware allocation of 3D Gaussians. By integrating texture-guided spatial partitioning with hierarchical sampling, CompactSplat adaptively distributes primitives - concentrating dense Gaussians in complex regions while tiling flat areas with expanded, scale-modulated primitives. Moreover, our framework inherently supports dynamic sparsity control at inference time, enabling seamless trade-offs between rendering fidelity and memory footprint without requiring network retraining. Extensive experiments on RealEstate10K, DL3DV, and ScanNet demonstrate that CompactSplat consistently outperforms prior methods on both standard metrics and high-resolution rendering consistency, achieving high-fidelity reconstructions with significantly fewer primitives.
hf.titleZh: CompactSplat：面向前馈场景重建的空间自适应高斯分布
hf.summaryZh: 稀疏视角下的前馈三维重建通常为每个像素均匀分配高斯，导致平坦区域出现大量冗余图元，且未能利用平面的几何先验。CompactSplat 将纹理引导的空间划分与层次采样结合，实现内容感知的高斯分配：复杂区域密集布点，平坦区域用放大的、尺度调制的高斯平铺，并支持推理时动态控制稀疏度，无需重训即可权衡渲染质量与显存占用。在 RealEstate10K、DL3DV 与 ScanNet 上，该方法在标准指标与高分辨率渲染一致性上均优于先前方法，且所用图元显著更少。
hf.reason: 3DGS 场景重建属视觉重建方向，与 LLM 关注点无关

hf.title: Think Harder Where It Matters: Item-Level Adaptive Recursion for Sequential Recommendation
hf.abstract: Existing sequential recommenders usually allocate a fixed computational budget to every item in a user's interaction history, regardless of the item's contribution to the final prediction. We challenge this de facto design with two diagnostic findings. (1) Non-uniform computational need: items within the same sequence vary drastically in how much computation they require. Most converge after shallow processing while a critical minority only stabilizes at full depth. (2) Suboptimality of fixed allocation: given oracle access to the target item, a non-uniform depth assignment consistently outranks the fixed one, indicating that existing uniform computation both wastes capacity on already-converged items and sacrifices overall recommendation quality. These observations motivate a shift from fixed-depth computation to item-level adaptive reasoning. To this end, we propose LoopRec. LoopRec recursively applies a single weight-shared block and introduces a lightweight gate at each recursion boundary that makes a binary exit-or-continue decision for every item independently. Items whose representations have sufficiently matured exit early, while those requiring deeper reasoning continue to subsequent recursions. This design converts the fixed global depth into a learned, per-item property without auxiliary depth labels, and is readily adaptable to diverse backbone architectures. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks with four backbone families demonstrate that LoopRec consistently outperforms matched fixed-depth counterparts. Further analysis reveals that LoopRec's learned allocation exhibits interpretable patterns aligned with our post-hoc oracle analysis: lower-frequency items and more recent interactions naturally receive deeper computation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Elpmis117/LoopRec.
hf.titleZh: 在关键处想得更久：面向序列推荐的物品级自适应递归
hf.summaryZh: 序列推荐通常为用户历史中的每个物品分配固定计算量，而该工作通过诊断实验发现：同一序列内物品所需计算深度差异悬殊，且 oracle 给定的非均匀深度分配稳定优于固定深度。为此提出 LoopRec，用单个权重共享块递归处理序列，并在每个递归边界设置轻量门控，对每个物品独立做出「退出或继续」的二值决策，从而把全局固定深度变为无需深度标签的、可学习的逐物品属性，且可适配多种骨干结构。在公开基准上的四个骨干系列中，LoopRec 均优于同计算量的固定深度版本，且学到的分配呈现可解释规律：低频物品与更近期的交互获得更深计算。
hf.reason: 自适应递归深度思路可迁移，但落在序列推荐垂直应用

hf.title: Entertain, then Cancel: How Thinking Makes Reasoning Models Read Some and Or Literally
hf.abstract: When a speaker says ``some students passed'', listeners infer that not all of them did. Reasoning models now let users decide how long a model thinks before it answers, but we do not know what extra thinking does to such everyday inferences. We study this directly: we keep a model's weights fixed, change only how much it thinks, and record which reading it chooses. A second tool cuts the model's own reasoning at successive points and asks for an answer, showing where the reading changes. Thinking makes models read logical words as logic: it cancels the implicatures of some (not all) and or (not both) in most tested open reasoning models and in GPT-5, while context-driven inferences such as indirect answers improve. The trace shows why: models first entertain the enriched reading and cancel it later. Answering from that early reading, an exploratory inference-time remedy, recovers these implicatures without losing literal accuracy. Evaluations of reasoning models should measure how they interpret, not only how accurate they are.
hf.titleZh: 先设想，后取消:思考如何让推理模型按字面解读 some 与 or
hf.summaryZh: 固定模型权重、只改变思考长度，考察推理模型对“some(并非全部)”“or(并非两者)”这类日常语用推断的影响:多数被测开源推理模型与GPT-5在思考后转向字面逻辑解读，取消了语用含义，而依赖上下文的间接回答等推断反而改善。逐点截断思维链显示，模型先采纳语用强化解读，随后再将其取消。据此提出的推理时干预——按早期解读作答——在不损失字面准确率的前提下恢复了这些语用含义;作者据此主张，推理模型评测应同时衡量其如何解读，而非只看准确率。
hf.reason: 考察思维链对语用推断的影响，属推理模型评测方法学

arxiv.title: Direct Pass@$k$ Optimization for Thought Pruning: Balancing Quality and Diversity in Test-Time Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Test-time scaling has emerged as a key inference strategy for reasoning models, where a model generates a large number of candidate solutions in the hope of finding at least one correct solution. Running all candidate solutions to completion can be computationally demanding, so recent work prunes the candidate pool after generating only a short prefix, committing further computation only to the surviving candidates. Existing pruning strategies divide broadly into two categories: Quality-based methods assign a score to each partial solution and discard those predicted to ultimately lead to an incorrect final solution, while diversity-based methods select partial solutions that follow different reasoning trajectories and are therefore likely to cover different final solutions. The tension between these two objectives is an instance of exploration versus exploitation, yet little to no prior work on pruning exposes this trade-off directly, let alone optimizes it. In this paper, we introduce a pruning procedure that addresses this trade-off directly by optimizing pass@$k$ over the selected solution pool. In particular, it chooses the pool to maximize the probability that at least one of its partial solutions, when continued to completion, yields a correct answer. Because this objective simultaneously rewards high-quality partial solutions and penalizes redundancy among them, quality and diversity are naturally balanced by the criterion itself rather than through separate ad-hoc design choices. On eight open-weight reasoning models, our method outperforms existing quality-based and diversity-based pruning strategies. The gains are particularly pronounced when the pruning procedure keeps a moderate number of partial solutions for continued generation, highlighting the value of directly balancing quality and diversity during pruning.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向思维剪枝的直接 Pass@$k$ 优化：在测试时推理中平衡质量与多样性
arxiv.summaryZh: 测试时扩展需要生成大量候选解，把每条候选都跑到结尾代价过高，现有前缀剪枝分为质量派与多样性派，二者的权衡一直未被显式优化。该工作把剪枝写成解池选择问题，直接最大化所选部分解在续写后至少有一个正确的概率，即 pass@k；该目标同时奖励高质量前缀并惩罚冗余，使质量与多样性由准则本身平衡，而不再依赖两套独立的启发式设计。在八个开放权重推理模型上，该方法优于现有质量型与多样性型剪枝策略，在保留中等数量候选继续生成时增益最明显。
arxiv.reason: 测试时推理剪枝，直接优化 pass@k，命中推理扩展方向

arxiv.title: Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification
arxiv.abstract: Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage. We evaluate cost-aware abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment: select a routing policy on calibration data under explicit costs, then evaluate that frozen policy once on held-out test data. On a public 47,837-ticket, eight-class corpus, we compare four trained non-LLM classifiers with four large language models under zero- and few-shot prompting. Under the illustrative cost model (c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong) = (0, 1, 5), TF-IDF with logistic regression and a threshold of 0.60 selected on calibration reduces test cost from 0.763 to 0.472, a 38.1% relative reduction (paired ratio-bootstrap 95% CI [35.7%, 40.4%]), while lowering wrong routes from 15.3% to 3.5%. Frozen calibration-selected policies also beat both always-route and always-defer on held-out test data in 14 of 16 settings in a post-hoc cost-parameter analysis. The strongest prompted configuration reaches 0.477 accuracy on a stratified 1,000-ticket test subset, versus 0.879 for fine-tuned DistilBERT on the same tickets. Isotonic lowers expected calibration error without reliably improving discrimination: GPT-4o-mini few-shot has one confidence value before and after recalibration and correctness AUROC 0.500. We therefore report correctness AUROC and tie-aware risk-coverage area alongside ECE. At the analytically derived break-even probability 0.80, seven prompted configurations defer all tickets; Haiku few-shot routes only 19/1,000. An LLM-only agreement control and margin/entropy rejection baselines further separate calibration from discrimination. The findings are scoped to this dataset, prompt design, model endpoints, and illustrative costs; the work is an evaluation framework, not a new abstention algorithm or universal deployment certification.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the 38th IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI 2026). 9 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables
arxiv.titleZh: LLM 驱动的 IT 工单分类中的成本感知弃权
arxiv.summaryZh: 把成本感知弃权当作离线、成本条件下的就绪度评估：先在校准集上按显式成本选定路由策略，再在留出测试集上一次性评估该冻结策略。在包含 47,837 条工单、8 个类别的公开语料上，TF-IDF 加逻辑回归配合校准选出的 0.60 阈值，在 (c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong)=(0,1,5) 成本下把测试成本从 0.763 降至 0.472（相对降低 38.1%），错误路由率从 15.3% 降至 3.5%；而表现最好的提示式 LLM 在 1,000 条测试子集上准确率仅 0.477，远低于微调 DistilBERT 的 0.879。等渗校准只压低 ECE 而不提升判别力，因此建议同时报告正确性 AUROC 与 risk-coverage 面积。
arxiv.reason: 属于 LLM 校准与弃权评估框架，但主任务为 IT 工单垂直应用

arxiv.title: METTA: Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation for Meta-Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Meta-reinforcement learning aims to train agents that adapt quickly to unseen tasks from limited interaction, but this requires representing task evidence over long interaction histories. Classical recurrent agents compress experience into hidden states, while transformer-based agents retrieve from past trajectories at quadratic memory and computation cost. In this work, we propose Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation (METTA) for meta-reinforcement learning. It decomposes the fast adaptation phase into two temporal scales: a causal neural memory performs fine-grained within-episode adaptation with linear sequence complexity, while compact episode-level summaries support long-range cross-episode task inference without attending over the full interaction history. Moreover, equipping agents with neural memory provides sufficient expressive capacity and test-time training capability, enabling effective adaptation to unseen held-out tasks and task families at meta-test time. On unseen held-out Meta-World ML10/45 test environments, METTA achieves a success rate over $50\%$ while maintaining a low training budget and short wall-clock time. On long-context sparse-reward PointMaze tasks, it outperforms transformer-based baselines by exhibiting more structured exploration behavior. These results show that METTA provides an efficient path toward more adaptive and scalable long-context meta-RL.
arxiv.titleZh: METTA：面向元强化学习的内存增强测试时自适应
arxiv.summaryZh: 元强化学习需要在长交互历史中表征任务证据，循环网络把经验压进隐状态，Transformer 则要以平方级显存与计算回看整条轨迹。METTA 把快速自适应拆成两个时间尺度：因果神经内存以线性复杂度完成回合内的细粒度自适应，回合级紧凑摘要支撑跨回合的长程任务推断，无需对全历史做注意力；神经内存同时带来更强的表达力与测试时训练能力。在未见过的 Meta-World ML10/45 上成功率超过50%，训练预算与耗时均较低；在长上下文稀疏奖励 PointMaze 上优于 Transformer 基线，探索行为更有结构。
arxiv.reason: 元强化学习与长上下文内存，属经典 RL，与 LLM 后训练仅有概念交集

arxiv.title: EpiSEM-Bench: Evaluating Safety and Evidence Recovery in LLM Agents under Missing Evidence
arxiv.abstract: Tool-using language model agents rely on environmental facts to decide whether an action is permitted. When a tool response omits a safety-relevant fact, an agent may carry out a prohibited action even though the user request is benign and every returned statement is true. We introduce \bench{}, an executable benchmark for evaluating unsafe execution, safety boundaries, and evidence recovery in LLM agents under missing evidence. It contains 300 matched unsafe/safe task pairs across six domains. By systematically suppressing critical facts, the benchmark measures unsafe execution under critical evidence omission and determines the minimum observed failure cardinality, including failures with full evidence and cases with no observed failure after exhaustive testing. An independent audit tool tests whether agents seek missing facts and then withhold prohibited actions while completing permissible tasks. The benchmark reveals substantial variation across the ten models in omission robustness, evidence acquisition, and appropriate action. Resistance to missing evidence does not necessarily translate into useful recovery. Recovery access reduces unsafe execution for all ten models, but agents differ in whether they actively obtain the missing facts and use them to act appropriately in both worlds.
arxiv.titleZh: EpiSEM-Bench：评估缺失证据下 LLM Agent 的安全性与证据恢复
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对工具调用 Agent 在工具响应遗漏安全相关事实时仍执行被禁止动作的问题，构建可执行 benchmark，包含六个领域 300 对匹配的不安全/安全任务，通过系统性抑制关键事实来测量不安全执行与最小失败基数，并用独立审计工具检验 Agent 是否主动寻求缺失事实，并在完成允许任务的同时拒绝禁止动作。十个模型在遗漏鲁棒性、证据获取与恰当行动上差异显著：获取缺失事实可降低所有模型的不安全执行率，但对缺失证据的抵抗力并不必然转化为有效恢复。
arxiv.reason: Agent 安全评测基准，方法扎实，命中 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: Low-Bit N-Gram Embeddings for Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Many recent open-weight language models use n-gram embedding tables to improve performance. These tables store learned representations of short token sequences, such as pairs or triples of consecutive tokens, which the model retrieves during processing. However, they can require substantial memory: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, for example, allocates 196 billion parameters to its Engram n-gram memory. We therefore investigate whether this memory cost can be reduced while preserving the performance improvement that the tables provide. We propose storing n-gram embeddings at low precision and systematically investigate different quantization methods and bit allocations across tables. Across nanochat-, Llama-, and GPT-2-family models trained from scratch, four-bit tables save approximately 75% of table memory while preserving more than 99% of the validation-loss improvement from adding the tables. Using fewer bits leads to a larger drop in performance, although we find that a short fine-tuning phase recovers a significant part of this loss. In addition, reinvesting the saved memory in larger tables can improve performance beyond that of the original full-precision tables while still using less memory. These table memory savings also extend to large existing models: on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, low-bit tables save 47-55% of table memory, with perplexity increases of less than 1.2% and largely preserved downstream task performance. These findings establish low-bit precision as a practical way to reduce the memory requirements of n-gram embeddings and use the saved capacity to improve model performance.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向语言模型的低位宽n-gram嵌入表
arxiv.summaryZh: n-gram嵌入表在近期开源权重模型中占用大量参数（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的Engram表即达1960亿参数），目标是在保住其性能收益的前提下削减这部分内存。工作系统比较了多种量化方法与跨表的比特分配策略，在nanochat、Llama与GPT-2系列从零训练的模型上验证：4比特表节省约75%的表内存，仍保留99%以上由加表带来的验证损失改善；更低比特损失更大，但短暂微调可挽回相当一部分。把省下的内存再投入更大的表，可在更低内存下超过全精度基线；在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash与Qwen3.8-Flash-Next上节省47–55%的表内存，困惑度上升不足1.2%，下游任务基本保持。
arxiv.reason: n-gram嵌入表低比特量化，命中LLM架构与系统效率方向

arxiv.title: A Fix for Softmax and Cross-Entropy
arxiv.abstract: Standard implementations of softmax, log-softmax, and cross-entropy have two numerical bugs. The first bug, Softmax Collapse, rounds the target logit's gradient to zero if that one logit is much larger than the others, resulting in gradients that no longer sum to zero. The second bug, Softmax Cancellation, occurs when student logits are close to teacher logits, and produces non-zero gradients even when the student and teacher logits are equal. We present simple implementations of log-softmax, softmax, and cross-entropy that fix both bugs. Our fix eliminates the previously-observed "Slingshot" phenomenon, speeds up grokking with weight decay, prevents accuracy collapse without weight decay, stops student networks from drifting away from the teacher during distillation, and shows that after memorization, logit growth is bounded by an equilibrium between weight decay and Adam's $ε$ hyperparameter.
arxiv.titleZh: Softmax 与交叉熵的一个修复
arxiv.summaryZh: 标准 softmax、log-softmax 与交叉熵实现存在两处数值缺陷：当目标 logit 远大于其他 logit 时，该 logit 的梯度被舍入为零，导致梯度之和不再为零（Softmax Collapse）；当学生与教师 logit 接近时仍产生非零梯度，即使两者完全相等（Softmax Cancellation）。论文给出同时修复这两处的简洁实现，实验上消除了此前观测到的「Slingshot」现象、加快带权重衰减的 grokking、避免无权重衰减时的精度崩塌、阻止蒸馏中学生网络偏离教师，并表明记忆完成后 logit 的增长受权重衰减与 Adam ε 超参之间的平衡约束。
arxiv.reason: 修复 softmax/交叉熵数值缺陷，牵涉蒸馏与训练稳定性

arxiv.title: Causal Chain of Thought: Mitigating Attention Leakage via Context Isolation
arxiv.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting elicits step-by-step rationales that appear to explain model predictions, but there is no guarantee these steps causally drive the final answer. In standard autoregressive generation, dense attention allows each reasoning step to attend to the full context, enabling the model to derive answers through direct lookup while generating plausible-sounding but post-hoc justifications. We introduce CausalCoT, an inference framework that enforces causal transparency by decomposing problems into a directed acyclic graph of atomic sub-questions, evaluating each node in an isolated context containing only its direct causal parents. This Markovian structure removes attention pathways to non-parent content, making downstream predictions sensitive to local reasoning rather than global context leakage. Across a diverse suite of reasoning benchmarks, CausalCoT preserves competitive predictive performance while improving explanation faithfulness, increasing causal sensitivity of intermediate reasoning steps by an average of 12 and up to 21 percentage points over the strongest baseline. The structured dependency graph additionally enables test-time interventions in which local corrections propagate predictably through downstream reasoning.
arxiv.titleZh: 因果思维链：通过上下文隔离缓解注意力泄漏
arxiv.summaryZh: 标准自回归生成中，每个推理步都能注意到完整上下文，模型可借直接查找得出答案，再生成看似合理的事后解释，使思维链缺乏因果忠实性。CausalCoT 在推理阶段把问题分解为由原子子问题构成的有向无环图，每个节点只在仅含其直接因果父节点的隔离上下文中求解，以马尔可夫结构切断指向非父节点的注意力通路。在多个推理基准上，预测性能与最强基线相当，中间推理步骤的因果敏感度平均提升12个百分点、最高提升21个百分点；依赖图还支持测试时的局部修正并沿图向下游可预测地传播。适用于需要可解释推理与可控纠错的高可靠推理场景。
arxiv.reason: 针对思维链因果忠实性的推理期结构改造，命中推理方向

arxiv.title: Can an Agent Debug a Web Corpus? Agentic Auditing of Slovak FineWeb2
arxiv.abstract: Multilingual pipelines such as FineWeb2 apply one recipe across a thousand languages, leaving the failure modes of individual languages unanticipated. We use an LLM once, as a corpus debugger rather than a classifier: a tool-using agent explores the corpus through a read-only, budgeted API and compiles each finding into an executable test, which a native speaker then validates. On the 26.5M-document Slovak portion of FineWeb2, three runs costing \$2.21-\$2.84 each found seven findings over four phenomena. The largest is a machine-generated content farm of 1,408,437 documents (5.32%) that passed the pipeline's filters, 86.6% of it passing even stricter thresholds. Blinded labels support 6 of the 7 findings (defect rates .53-1.00 against .08 in a random control) and do not support one. The compiled suite scans the full corpus in 0.7 s of wall-clock time without a GPU, against \$12k-\$90k per LLM classification pass. The best static sampling baseline validates more selectors than any agent run, at under half the cost. The agent contributes exact prevalence, a precision estimate checked against sampled documents, an account of why the pipeline missed each slice, and a reusable test. We release the framework, Slovak test suite, validation data and agent trajectories.
arxiv.comment: Accepted to WaC Workshop at EMNLP 2026
arxiv.titleZh: 一个 Agent 能调试网页语料吗？对 Slovak FineWeb2 的智能体审计
arxiv.summaryZh: 多语言预训练语料流水线（如 FineWeb2）用同一套配方覆盖上千种语言，单语失效模式难以预估。工作把 LLM 当作语料调试器而非分类器：工具调用型 Agent 通过只读、限额 API 探索语料，把每项发现编译成可执行测试，再由母语者校验。在 FineWeb2 斯洛伐克语 2650 万文档子集上，三次运行各花费 2.21–2.84 美元，覆盖四类现象共 7 项发现，最大一处是 140 万文档（5.32%）的机器生成内容农场绕过原有过滤，其中 86.6% 连更严格阈值也能通过。编译后的测试套件 0.7 秒扫完全量语料且无需 GPU，而一次 LLM 分类需 1.2 万–9 万美元；但最佳静态采样基线以不到一半成本验证出更多选择器。
arxiv.reason: 语料质量审计加 Agent 工具调用，方向贴合但 workshop 规模、结论偏弱

arxiv.title: BeNice! Closing Looping's Inference-Memory Gap via KV-Sharing
arxiv.abstract: Looped architectures scale quality while keeping parameter count fixed by repeatedly passing activations through the same block of layers. During inference, each recurrence generates independent KV-caches, causing memory to grow linearly. To address this challenge, prior work has proposed KV-sharing (i.e., sharing KV-caches across depth), finding that, in some cases, the KV-cache of the final recurrence can be shared with the earlier recurrences without quality loss, a property we denote as KV-shareability. However, the mechanisms underlying KV-shareability remain poorly understood, with even identically trained looped architectures not consistently exhibiting it. In this paper, we study how KV-shareability can be enabled in looped models. We propose a two-stage method: in the first stage, we use stochastic depth during pretraining, which induces contractive residual dynamics that drive representations toward a common limit across recurrences. In the second stage, we propose BeNice!, a post-training method that broadcasts the final recurrence's KV-cache into the first recurrence, training it to produce compatible residuals while preserving the original model's quality. As a result, BeNice! enables KV-shareability while matching standard finetuning's unshared validation perplexity. Using BeNice!, we show that KV-sharing is complementary to alternative KV-compression methods, composing with memory-efficient sequence mixers (e.g., multi-latent attention, Kimi delta attention) and low-precision KV-cache quantization (e.g., fp8, mxfp8, nvfp4). Finally, in simulated low-memory, long-context inference, KV-sharing improves cache hit rates by up to 31.4%, increases throughput by up to 23.6%, and reduces p90 time-to-first-token by up to 83.6%.
arxiv.titleZh: BeNice!：以 KV 共享弥合循环式架构的推理内存鸿沟
arxiv.summaryZh: 循环式（looped）架构重复复用同一组层以固定参数量提升质量，但推理时每次循环都生成独立 KV-cache，显存随循环深度线性增长。此前观察到末次循环的 KV-cache 可与前序循环共享而不掉质量（KV-shareability），却缺乏机制解释、也非稳定复现。该工作给出两阶段方案：预训练阶段引入 stochastic depth 诱导收缩性残差动力学，使各次循环表征收敛到共同极限；后训练阶段提出 BeNice!，将末次循环的 KV-cache 广播至首次循环，训练其产出兼容残差，在匹配标准微调的不共享验证困惑度下实现 KV 共享。该方法与 multi-latent attention、Kimi delta attention 及 fp8/mxfp8/nvfp4 低精度 KV 量化可叠加，模拟低显存长上下文推理中缓存命中率最高提升 31.4%，吞吐提升 23.6%，首 token 时延 p90 降低 83.6%。
arxiv.reason: 循环架构推理 KV 共享，命中架构与推理效率方向，方法新且数据扎实

arxiv.title: Questioning Instrumental Convergence in RLVR: Checkpoint Evidence from OLMo-3
arxiv.abstract: Instrumental convergence is often invoked as a general reason to expect capable agents to acquire or express power-seeking subgoals: self-preservation, resource acquisition, deception, or resistance to oversight which poses an important threat to the society. For LLMs, reinforcement learning is the first stage of post-training that directly optimizes behavior against an objective; therefore, it is the stage where convergent instrumental behavior, on IC grounds, likely to appear. Does reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) make a model more likely to express instrumental-convergence behavior, or does this depend on the training regime, evaluation frame, and stage of post-training? We study this question as a checkpoint-conditioned behavioral trajectory rather than as a single before/after safety score. Using InstrumentalEval, we evaluate OLMo-3-7B-Think across SFT, DPO, 13 intermediate RLVR checkpoints, and the final RLVR model. The trajectory is nonmonotonic: instrumental rate rises from 25.0% at SFT to 46.1% near RLVR step 200, then falls to 11.8% at the final checkpoint. Paired item-level tests and step-wise regression support the final SFT-to-RLVR reduction. Prompt framing does not explain this pattern: a harmful-prompt indicator combined with other framing effects explains only 15% of within-checkpoint score variance on average, and Iterative Null-space Projection (INLP) removes a detectable framing direction without changing the SFT-to-final-RLVR gap. Together with preliminary 32B endpoint results (35.53% SFT to 22.37% RLVR final), these findings indicate that RLVR does not monotonically increase instrumental behavior in this setting: the rate rises early, then falls below the SFT baseline. The result is specific to this model family and benchmark, and judge agreement is moderate, so absolute rates should be read cautiously.
arxiv.titleZh: 质疑 RLVR 中的工具性收敛：来自 OLMo-3 检查点的证据
