arxiv.summaryZh: 检验可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）是否会让模型更倾向表现出工具性收敛行为（自我保护、资源获取、欺骗、抗拒监督）。以 OLMo-3-7B-Think 为对象，用 InstrumentalEval 沿 SFT、DPO、13 个中间 RLVR 检查点与最终模型评测行为轨迹：工具性行为率从 SFT 的 25.0% 升至 RLVR 约 200 步的 46.1%，再降至最终检查点的 11.8%，32B 端点结果同向（35.53% 降至 22.37%）。逐条配对检验与逐步回归支持 SFT 到最终 RLVR 的下降；提示框架（prompt framing）只解释检查点内约 15% 的分数方差，用 INLP 去除可检测的框架方向后差距依然存在。结果表明该设定下 RLVR 并不单调提升工具性行为，绝对比率受模型族与基准限制、评判一致性中等，需谨慎解读。
arxiv.reason: RLVR 后训练行为分析，方法扎实但属诊断性研究

arxiv.title: Bilingual Language Models Capture Cross-Linguistic Influence in Second-Language Reading
arxiv.abstract: While monolingual language model (LM) surprisal is widely established as a predictor of reading times, it cannot capture the non-native (L2) reading dynamics that are shaped by the reader's first language (L1). In this work, we investigate whether the cross-lingual transfer within bilingual models aligns with human L1-driven biases during L2 reading. We evaluate bilingual models on eye-tracking data of readers from 12 diverse L1 backgrounds reading English texts. To isolate L1-specific transfer, we compare bilingual models trained on an L1 that matches the readers' L1 background to both a monolingual English baseline and bilingual models trained on other L1s. We demonstrate that matching the readers' L1 improves the prediction of L2 reading times. This predictive advantage is concentrated in late-stage eye-tracking measures, modulated by L1-L2 script overlap, and peaks among intermediate-proficiency readers. These findings provide evidence that bilingual LMs capture aspects of cross-linguistic influence, and that such influence is present in L2 reading behavior.
arxiv.titleZh: 双语语言模型捕捉第二语言阅读中的跨语言影响
arxiv.summaryZh: 单语语言模型的surprisal虽能预测阅读时间，却无法刻画由母语(L1)塑造的二语(L2)阅读动态。研究在12种不同L1背景读者阅读英语文本的眼动数据上评测双语模型，把以读者母语训练的双语模型与单语英语基线、以及其他L1训练的双语模型对比，以隔离L1特异的迁移效应。结果显示，匹配读者L1可提升L2阅读时间的预测精度，该优势集中于晚期眼动指标，受L1与L2书写系统重叠程度调节，并在中等熟练度读者中最为显著。这为双语语言模型能够捕捉跨语言影响、且该影响体现在真实L2阅读行为中提供了证据。
arxiv.reason: 心理语言学眼动建模，用多语言LM验证跨语言迁移，偏离主方向

arxiv.title: OP-Print: Tracing Membership Imprints in On-Policy Self-Distillation
arxiv.abstract: On-policy distillation has been widely adopted for alleviating the distribution mismatch of off-policy distillation. Self-distillation further removes the need for an external teacher by using the student's own outputs, enhanced with extra context or demonstrations, as supervision. This teacher-free design makes on-policy self-distillation practical, yet its privacy risks remain largely unexplored. In particular, using two coupled views of the same training example may strengthen its memorization. Motivated by this, we present the first study of membership inference attacks against on-policy self-distillation. We investigate both gray-box and black-box threat models and propose a unified attack framework, named OP-Print. OP-Print builds on our finding that the supervision imprint in on-policy self-distillation is sparse and structured, concentrating on uncertainty-sensitive correction sites rather than across the entire rollout. Exploiting this property, we construct attack signals tailored to the two access levels: in the gray-box setting, OP-Print directly aggregates the privileged teacher-student residual correction along the same rollout; in the black-box setting, it measures restart-based output-basin stability as an observable surrogate for the hidden correction process. Across diverse models and distillation schemes, all baseline attacks remain essentially at random guessing even under gray-box access, whereas OP-Print is broadly validated to be effective in both gray-box and black-box settings.
arxiv.titleZh: OP-Print：追踪在策略自蒸馏中的成员印记
arxiv.summaryZh: 在策略自蒸馏用同一训练样本的两个耦合视图做监督，可能加重记忆与隐私泄漏，但此前缺乏成员推断角度的系统评估。OP-Print发现其监督印记稀疏且结构化，集中于对不确定性敏感的纠正位置；灰盒下聚合同一rollout上特权教师—学生残差纠正，黑盒下用重启后的输出盆地稳定性作为隐藏纠正过程的代理信号。跨多种模型与蒸馏方案，基线攻击即使灰盒访问也基本等同随机猜测，而OP-Print在灰盒与黑盒设置下均被验证有效。
arxiv.reason: 在策略自蒸馏的隐私攻击研究，命中蒸馏方向但非核心关注

arxiv.title: Efficient and Optimal Learning of Discrete Distributions with Person-Level Privacy
arxiv.abstract: We study learning a discrete distribution under person-level differential privacy in the batched setting. Given $n$ users, each contributing $m$ i.i.d. samples from an unknown distribution $μ$ over $[k]$, we seek an estimate of $μ$ with total-variation error $α$. We give polynomial-time algorithms under both pure and approximate differential privacy. Under pure $(\varepsilon,0)$-DP, we achieve $n = \widetilde O(k/(α^2 m)+k/(α\sqrt{m}\varepsilon)+k/\varepsilon)$, the first polynomial-time pure-DP guarantee matching the information-theoretic optimum up to logarithmic factors. Under approximate $(\varepsilon,δ)$-DP, we achieve $n = \widetilde O(k/(α^2 m)+k/(α\sqrt{m}\varepsilon)+k+\log(1/δ)/\varepsilon)$. At $δ=2^{-Θ(k)}$, this is $\widetilde O(k)$ for fixed $α,\varepsilon,m$ and failure probability. Our algorithms use a new degree-6 sum-of-squares estimator for learning from untrusted batches. Its key ingredient is a trace-bounded diagonal majorizer for the difference between the empirical covariance of the repaired batch averages and the multinomial covariance predicted by their mean. We prove that clean data admit this certificate through semidefinite-programming duality and a new application of the stronger symmetric form of Grothendieck's inequality due to Friedland and Lim. The certificate preserves the mean-dependent variance of multinomial batch averages, yielding the near-optimal robust rate $O(η\sqrt{\log(1/η)/m})$ and providing the score required by the privacy reduction. We also prove a statistical query lower bound ruling out a uniformly smaller order of error under fixed polynomial SQ resource bounds.
arxiv.comment: Full version of the SODA 2027 paper
arxiv.titleZh: 具有人员级隐私的离散分布高效最优学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 解决批处理模式下人员级差分隐私的离散分布估计问题：n 个用户各贡献 m 个独立同分布样本，目标是以总变差误差 α 恢复分布 μ。给出纯 DP 与近似 DP 下的多项式时间算法，纯 (ε,0)-DP 所需用户数为 Õ(k/(α²m)+k/(α√mε)+k/ε)，是首个在忽略对数因子意义下匹配信息论最优的多项式时间纯 DP 保证；近似 (ε,δ)-DP 在 δ=2^{-Θ(k)} 时降至 Õ(k)。方法核心是面向不可信批次的新六次平方和估计器，关键在于用半正定规划对偶与 Friedland–Lim 对称 Grothendieck 不等式构造迹有界的对角占优证书，保持多项批次均值的均值依赖方差，从而得到近最优稳健速率 O(η√(log(1/η)/m))；另给出统计查询下界。
arxiv.reason: 纯 DP 与平方和理论，与 LLM 方向无交集

arxiv.title: How Ground Truth Shapes Retrieval Scores: Evidence-Aware Evaluation of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation System for Breast Lesions
arxiv.abstract: Purpose: To describe an evidence-aware retrieval evaluation protocol for a clinical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system over breast lesion management literature, addressing the dependence of retrieval scores on annotation coverage. Methods: An 18-document corpus and an 18-query development benchmark, with one Yes/No or WH-question per document, were used. Retrieval combined dense embeddings, BM25, and cross-encoder reranking. Chunk sizes of 128 to 1024 tokens, overlaps of 0 to 20%, and four retriever configurations were evaluated. Relevance was defined by evidence spans mapped to all containing chunks, treating overlapping chunks with equivalent evidence as relevant. Retrieval was evaluated using R-Precision, Recall@K, MRR, and nDCG@K. Separately, generation was assessed on a 512-token index at K=1 to 5 using DeepEval claim-level metrics, with deepseek-v4-pro as the LLM judge, and BLEU/ROUGE metrics. Results: The selected hybrid retriever, using 384-token chunks and 20% overlap, retrieved accepted evidence in the top three results for 17 of 18 queries. Recall@3, R-Precision, MRR@3, and nDCG@3 each reached 0.94. Ground-truth curation increased evidence spans from 25 to 37 and accepted chunk targets from 36 to 51 without changing retrieval rankings. Conclusion: Cross-encoder reranking achieved the highest retrieval scores. Expanded relevance annotations increased recognized evidence without changing rankings, highlighting annotation sensitivity. The small development set and retrieval-informed curation require independent validation, including radiologist assessment of evidence sufficiency.
arxiv.titleZh: 真值如何塑造检索分数：面向乳腺病灶 RAG 系统的证据感知评测
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向临床乳腺病灶管理文献的 RAG 系统，提出证据感知的检索评测协议，以解决检索分数依赖标注覆盖度的问题。构建 18 篇文档、18 条查询的开发基准，检索融合稠密向量、BM25 与 cross-encoder 重排，并扫描 128–1024 token 分块与 0–20% 重叠；相关性由证据片段映射到所有包含该片段的分块来定义。最优配置为 384 token 分块、20% 重叠的混合检索器，18 条查询中 17 条在前三条结果中命中证据，Recall@3、R-Precision、MRR@3、nDCG@3 均为 0.94。人工扩增真值后，证据片段由 25 增至 37，可接受分块目标由 36 增至 51，但检索排序并未改变，说明评测对标注方式很敏感；该研究规模较小，结论需独立验证。
arxiv.reason: 临床文本 RAG 评测，方向擦边且开发集规模极小

arxiv.title: CRANE: Post-Hoc Counterfactual Retrieval for Multimodal Classifiers
arxiv.abstract: Counterfactual explanation methods have been introduced for unimodal settings, with dedicated frameworks for tabular, timeseries, text, and image data, yet no post-hoc method has been designed for classifiers that learn from multimodal inputs. Existing explainability methods for multimodal classifiers apply modality-specific attribution independently to each input, which fails to yield coherent explanations and does not transfer to arbitrary pre-trained multimodal architectures. To address these shortcomings, we present CRANE (Counterfactual Retrieval via Agnostic Nearest-neighbour Explanations), the first post-hoc, model-agnostic framework for nearest-neighbour multimodal counterfactual generation that retrieves real training examples from the target class as candidate explanations, ensuring plausibility by construction. Across four heterogeneous datasets and three fusion strategies, we show that Multimodal Consensus Retrieval (MC-R), which intersects per-modality neighbour sets to identify instances jointly close to the query in every modality, emerges as the strongest multimodal strategy, achieving the best or joint-best outcome on three of four datasets while grounding every explanation in the joint training distribution. Unimodal strategies remain competitive when a single modality dominates the decision boundary.
arxiv.comment: 7 pages + references, 3 figures, accepted to DSAA 2026
arxiv.titleZh: CRANE：面向多模态分类器的后验反事实检索
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有多模态分类器解释方法对每个模态独立做归因，解释不连贯且难以迁移到任意预训练架构。CRANE把反事实解释转化为检索问题：从目标类别的真实训练样本中检索近邻作为候选解释，以模型无关的后验方式保证解释在构造上就合理可信。在四个异构数据集与三种融合策略上，对各模态近邻集合取交集的Multimodal Consensus Retrieval（MC-R）在四个数据集中的三个取得最佳或并列最佳，且每条解释都落在联合训练分布内；当单一模态主导决策边界时，单模态策略仍有竞争力。该框架适用于需要对多模态分类决策做可信解释的场景。

arxiv.title: Simulated Control Evals
arxiv.abstract: Control evaluations measure whether safeguards can prevent an AI model from causing undesired outcomes even when it is intentionally trying to do so. These evaluations typically use purpose-built control settings and extrapolate their results to a model's deployment. However, the effectiveness of safeguards in deployment can depend on features of environments and tasks that control settings do not represent. To broaden where control evaluations can be run, we introduce simulated control evaluations (SCEs), which use a language model to simulate tool responses in place of an environment. We evaluate SCEs on LinuxArena, where execution provides ground-truth outcomes. We compare SCE prediction errors with those from a separate control setting, BashArena, and with variation in control metrics within LinuxArena. For independently sampled evaluation and deployment task sets, SCEs predict safety with a root mean squared error of 3.6 percentage points across five monitors at a 5% audit budget, compared with 10.1 for BashArena. SCEs closely reproduce distributions of attack strategies, attacker reasoning, and monitor reasoning, with over tenfold lower KL divergence from execution than BashArena. SCEs explain 78-85% of the between-environment variance in attack success, monitor scores, and safety. This accuracy is sample efficient: SCEs predict safety with less error than BashArena using fewer than 5% as many task-pair draws as the deployment task set. Strategies discovered through simulation also improve monitor performance on held-out LinuxArena attacks, outperforming BashArena and approximately matching improvement from executed strategies. These results suggest that deployment-specific SCEs can be more predictive than control evaluations executed in separate control settings.
arxiv.titleZh: 模拟控制评估
arxiv.summaryZh: 控制评估通常依赖专门构建的控制环境，再把结果外推到真实部署，但部署环境与任务特性会影响防护措施的实际效果。模拟控制评估（SCEs）用语言模型模拟工具响应来替代真实环境，从而在更广泛的任务上开展控制评估。在 LinuxArena 上，5% 审计预算、五个监控器设定下，SCEs 预测安全性的 RMSE 为 3.6 个百分点（BashArena 为 10.1），与执行结果的 KL 散度低一个数量级以上，可解释 78–85% 的环境间方差，且所用任务对不足部署任务集的 5%。这说明面向具体部署的 SCEs 比在独立控制环境中执行的控制评估更具预测力。

arxiv.title: VERA: A Responsible AI Dashboard for Assessing LLM Deployments in Light of the EU AI Act
arxiv.abstract: Institutions that deploy large language models in regulated settings often need technical evidence of responsible AI practices before approving a deployment. COMPL-AI provides a technical interpretation of the EU AI Act that organises this evidence under six principle groups and eighteen technical requirements, twelve of which current benchmarks can measure. The benchmark suites that produce this evidence are typically operated from a command line, while the staff who approve deployments are non-engineers. We present VERA, an open-source self-hosted dashboard deployed to facilitate responsible AI processes within a large European bank. A reviewer selects a model and runs public benchmarks against it. VERA scores the twelve requirements that current benchmarks can measure and instruments the energy consumed by each evaluation, adding run-level evidence for environmental impact. We run four served open-weight models through the requirement pipeline, and the dashboard displays a score for each measurable requirement. A within-subject study then compares how participants read these benchmark results: from the raw output files in one condition, and through the VERA dashboard in the other. The dashboard reduced the time needed to perform the responsible AI assessment, reducing the time required from 56 seconds using raw files to 30 seconds using our dashboard, on average. Our dashboard scored highly (4.36 out of 5) on usefulness in the survey conducted within the organization. The dashboard and the study material are released publicly to promote replicability and reproducibility in different organisational contexts.

arxiv.title: Would an LLM Match into a Residency? Uncertainty, Reasoning and Image Use of Open Language Models on the Spanish MIR Examination
arxiv.abstract: Accuracy on medical examinations is common evidence offered for the clinical use of language models, yet a health system that intends to run an open model on its own hardware needs to know considerably more: whether the model recognizes when it is likely to be wrong, whether medical fine-tuning improves this ability, whether its correct answers rest on sound clinical reasoning, or whether it actually uses the images it is given. We examine these questions for four open models of 8 to 27 billion parameters on the Spanish MIR residency examination, scoring 1,552 questions from eight editions under the exam's own rules. Answering every question, the three larger models would rank among roughly the first 600 to 3,000 candidates, with 41 to 43 specialties still open to them. Abstention, however, never pays, because even their least confident answers are right more often than the 25% break-even. Medical fine-tuning reduced overconfidence at the cost of accuracy, without improving how well confidence separates right from wrong answers. Moreover, 13-38% of correct answers rejected a distractor for a clinically unsound reason that confidence did not reflect, and removing or swapping the provided contextual images left accuracy unchanged.
arxiv.titleZh: LLM 能匹配上住院医师岗位吗？开放语言模型在西班牙 MIR 考试中的不确定性、推理与图像使用
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向医疗机构在自有硬件上部署开放模型的实际需求，在西班牙 MIR 住院医师考试 8 个考次的 1552 道题上，按考试自身规则评测 4 个 8B–27B 参数模型，考察其置信度校准、弃答策略、推理合理性与对给定图像的利用。三个较大模型若全部作答，约可排在第 600–3000 名，仍有 41–43 个专科可选；但弃答从不划算，因为即使最不自信的作答，正确率也高于 25% 的盈亏线。医学微调降低了过度自信却牺牲了准确率，且未改善置信度区分正误的能力；13–38% 的正确作答以临床上不成立的理由排除了干扰项，而置信度并未反映这一点；移除或替换题目附带的图像后准确率不变。

arxiv.title: Action Learning for Scientific Simulations
arxiv.abstract: Understanding and controlling how systems evolve is central to science and engineering, where many problems require reasoning about complete trajectories. Existing approaches typically learn local dynamics or generate trajectories, but objectives constructed from individual transitions can miss dependencies across time, while generative models do not necessarily provide a tractable objective for evaluating and optimizing arbitrary paths. We study $\textit{action learning}$, the problem of recovering a stochastic action from trajectory observations, yielding a common objective for reasoning about dynamical systems. We introduce $\textbf{LEAP}$ ($\textbf{L}$earned $\textbf{E}$nergy on $\textbf{A}$ction $\textbf{P}$aths), which anchors the unknown action to a tractable reference process and learns the remaining correction by comparing observed trajectories with reference trajectories. This construction yields a differentiable objective on path space that can capture both local dynamical structure and nonadditive dependencies across time. Once learned, the same action can be flexibly reused for path ranking and inference, mechanism steering, constrained optimization and sampling. Across stochastic physical systems, many-body orbital dynamics and molecular simulations, LEAP recovers underlying dynamics, captures dependencies across time and enables transfer across inference objectives and physical conditions. We show that $\textit{action learning}$ is a promising framework for turning trajectory observations into reusable objectives for scientific inference and control.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向科学模拟的作用量学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有方法多从单步转移学习局部动力学或直接生成轨迹，前者难以刻画跨时间依赖，后者不提供可评估与优化任意路径的显式目标。LEAP将未知的随机作用量锚定到可处理的参考过程，通过比较观测轨迹与参考轨迹学习剩余修正项，在路径空间上得到可微目标，兼顾局部动力学结构与跨时间的非可加依赖。在随机物理系统、多体轨道动力学与分子模拟中，该方法恢复了潜在动力学、捕捉了时间依赖，并可跨推断目标与物理条件迁移；学到的同一作用量还能复用于路径排序与推断、机制操控、约束优化与采样。

arxiv.title: Who Is Sycophantic to Whom? Confident LLMs, Human Deference, and the Collapse of Trust Calibration
arxiv.abstract: Research on sycophancy asks whether large language models (LLMs) bend towards what their users want to hear. We ask the reverse question: when an LLM is confident, consistent, and wrong, do users bend towards it? In a within-subjects experiment, 32 participants learned up to five science topics by chatting with five assistants built on the same model (GPT-5-mini). Unknown to participants, each assistant's briefing had 0, 25, 50, 75, or 100% of its facts replaced by plausible falsehoods, and every assistant spoke with full confidence. A surprise quiz after each topic offered the correct fact, the planted falsehood, and two distractors, with a confidence rating for every answer. Across 104 quizzes and 1,040 answers, scores fell from 7.4 to 2.9 out of 10, and the planted option was chosen on 60% of falsified items against 11% of correctly taught ones (odds ratio 12.5). Transcript coding showed that whenever the assistant stated a falsehood, it was adopted about 65% of the time at every falsification level. Absorbed falsehoods were held with high confidence (8.4/10), the modeled confidence advantage of right over wrong answers vanished, and the discrimination of confidence for correctness fell from an AUROC of 0.70 to chance, while post-task trust ratings barely moved. Participants tended to return to the chat more when the assistant was worse, but returning went with more absorption, not less, and 30% of all turns pasted quiz questions back to the source being checked. The assistant itself was almost never sycophantic and never conceded under pushback. We introduce a baseline-corrected Human Deference Index to quantify this human-side sycophancy and argue that trustworthiness is a property of the human-AI pair, that sycophancy evaluations should measure both directions, and that learning interfaces must make reliability legible claim by claim.
arxiv.titleZh: 谁在向谁谄媚？自信的LLM、人类的顺从与信任校准的崩塌
arxiv.summaryZh: 把谄媚研究的提问方向反转过来：当LLM自信、前后一致却给出错误内容时，用户会不会反过来顺从它。32名被试在同一模型GPT-5-mini搭建的五个助手上学习至多五个科学主题，各助手陈述中分别有0、25%、50%、75%、100%的事实被替换成似是而非的错误说法，且一律以十足自信的口吻表达；每个主题后安排突袭测验，给出正确项、植入错误项与两个干扰项，并要求对每个答案给出置信度。104份测验、1040个答案显示，得分从7.4跌至2.9（满分10），被篡改条目上植入项被选中的比例为60%，而正确讲授条目仅11%（优势比12.5）；助手说出错误时约65%被采纳，且各篡改比例下相同，采纳的错误以8.4/10的高置信持有，置信度对正确性的区分AUROC从0.70降到随机水平，而任务后信任评分几乎不变。作者据此提出经基线校正的人类顺从指数（Human Deference Index），主张可信度是人机配对的属性、谄媚评测应双向测量。

arxiv.title: What Makes a Good Unmasking Policy? A Controlled Study of Learned Unmasking in Diffusion Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Masked diffusion language models generate tokens in parallel, but their efficiency depends on which predictions are committed. Learned unmasking policies improve the speed--accuracy trade-off, yet differ in supervision, inputs, and capacity, obscuring which choices matter. We view supervised policies as distilling a decoding procedure through a teacher and examine independently what the teacher labels as committable, on which states the policy imitates it, what the policy observes, and how much the number of function evaluations (NFE) must decrease to offset policy overhead. We find that labeling predictions matching the final output is overly permissive at low NFE, and hidden states are weak alone but can complement confidence. About a 10% NFE reduction suffices to offset policy overhead for policies up to 7.5M parameters across tested settings. We therefore train a policy on trajectory-contraction targets, which accept only commitments staying on a reference trajectory, using confidence and hidden states. On LLaDA-8B-Instruct, the resulting 856K-parameter policy achieves the best accuracy--NFE frontier and highest throughput on GSM8K, is competitive at moderate targets on MATH-500 and HumanEval, and largely transfers to Dream-7B-Instruct.
arxiv.titleZh: 什么构成好的解掩码策略？对扩散语言模型中学习式解掩码的受控研究
arxiv.summaryZh: 并行解码的扩散语言模型效率取决于提交哪些预测，学习式解掩码策略在监督、输入与容量上各不相同，难以判断哪些设计真正关键。该工作把监督策略视为对解码过程的蒸馏，分别考察教师标注何为可提交、在哪些状态上模仿、策略观测什么，以及需降低多少NFE才能抵消开销；发现低NFE下「与最终输出一致」的标签过于宽松，隐藏状态可补充置信度，约10%NFE降幅即可抵消7.5M参数以内策略的开销。据此以轨迹收缩目标结合置信度与隐藏状态训练856K参数策略，在LLaDA-8B-Instruct的GSM8K上取得最佳精度-NFE前沿与最高吞吐，并可迁移到Dream-7B-Instruct。

arxiv.title: Rethinking Sequence Compression with Test-time Regression
arxiv.abstract: Sequence compression is a fundamental operation and a critical information bottleneck in efficient language and multimodal models, and yet prevailing approaches based on pooling or learned projections remain underperforming. We revisit sequence compression through the lens of test-time regression: input tokens define a regression problem whose fitted coefficients form the compressed representation. Importantly, the regression problem is learned end-to-end via backpropagation, while its coefficients are computed efficiently in closed form during the forward pass. This leads to TTR-Compressor, a general alternative to conventional pooling and projection-based compression. We evaluate TTR-Compressor as the compressor for block-wise sparse attention and the visual token merger for multimodal large language models. On block-wise sparse attention, TTR-Compressor improves RULER performance over attention-based compressors by a large margin. For visual token merging, it consistently outperforms the standard MLP merger and matches its performance with 55.6% fewer visual tokens. These results establish test-time regression as an effective primitive for sequence compression in efficient language and multimodal models.
arxiv.comment: Technical report (19 pages, 4 figures, project page: https://spherelab.ai/ttr-compressor)
arxiv.titleZh: 以测试时回归重新思考序列压缩
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对高效语言与多模态模型中序列压缩这一关键信息瓶颈，把输入 token 视为回归问题的观测，用拟合出的系数作为压缩表示：回归问题通过反向传播端到端学习，而系数在前向时以闭式解高效求得，从而成为池化与学习投影式压缩的通用替代方案。在 block-wise 稀疏注意力中，TTR-Compressor 相比基于注意力的压缩器在 RULER 上大幅提升；在视觉 token 合并中，它稳定优于标准 MLP merger，并在视觉 token 减少 55.6% 时达到同等性能。该结果把测试时回归确立为序列压缩的有效原语，适用于长上下文与 MLLM 推理效率场景。

arxiv.title: On the Token Collapse Phenomenon in Textual Graph Soft Prompting
arxiv.abstract: Recent methods for injecting graph structure into LLM prompts include graph soft prompting, in which a graph neural network (GNN) learns graph-specific tokens that capture relational information among entities in textual prompts. G-Retriever combines graph soft prompts with a verbalized description of the same graph to strengthen the textual prompt signal. We conduct an in-depth analysis of G-Retriever and uncover a pathological behavior we term token collapse. Across three benchmarks, three graph encoders, two LLM families, and both frozen and LoRA-adapted models, G-Retriever's graph tokens become almost indistinguishable across inputs. We provide evidence that the same failure is inherited by subsequent methods, even with multi-token pooling. Under the standard setup, swapping a token with the dataset mean, a token from another example, or one derived from a corrupted graph produces no resolved answer-level effect in accuracy. Moreover, a learned constant prompt that never accesses the graph matches or surpasses G-Retriever on all three benchmarks. These findings indicate that, rather than conveying graph content as intended, the collapsed token functions primarily as a generic soft prompt. We also examine conditions linked to this collapse and propose a two-stage procedure that yields non-collapsed tokens while maintaining competitive performance in most cases. However, token variability alone does not prove that the model uses graph information: via interventions and decoding probes, we show that depending on the configuration, a token can reflect the question, an answer prior, or graph-derived content that the LLM may or may not use. Overall, our results offer a practical approach to evaluating graph-token alignment rather than inferring it from task accuracy alone. Code to reproduce our experiments is available at https://github.com/difra100/Token_Collapse_KGQA.
arxiv.titleZh: 论文本图软提示中的 Token 坍缩现象
arxiv.summaryZh: 深入分析 G-Retriever 这类把图结构以软提示注入 LLM 的方法，发现 token 坍缩现象:在三个基准、三种图编码器、两种 LLM 家族及冻结/LoRA 两种设置下，图 token 在不同输入间几乎不可区分。将 token 替换为数据集均值、其他样本的 token 或由损坏图生成的 token，准确率均无变化;一个不接触图的常量可学习提示在三个基准上追平甚至超过 G-Retriever，说明坍缩后的 token 只起通用软提示作用。进一步给出两阶段流程以获得非坍缩 token，并用干预与解码探针表明 token 可能编码问题、答案先验或图内容，主张以对齐评估替代单看任务准确率。

arxiv.title: When to Follow the Teacher: Advantage-Based On-Policy Distillation
arxiv.abstract: Online Policy Distillation (OPD) often outperforms offline methods such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) by training on trajectories sampled directly from the student. However, standard OPD trains the student to follow the teacher at every state of the trajectory, assuming that teacher guidance is always beneficial. We instead distinguish between what the teacher prefers and what actually helps the current student succeed. We introduce Advantage-Based On-Policy Distillation (AOPD), which weights teacher actions by their counterfactual advantage under the student. Teacher actions that improve the student's expected outcome are reinforced, while those that do not are downweighted. Directly computing these advantages requires trying alternative teacher actions at each step and running new rollouts from each. Instead, we show that the AOPD objective can be estimated using only standard student rollouts and their terminal rewards. Our estimator uses teacher importance weights on the student-sampled actions to provide unbiased advantage-weighted supervision, without any additional rollouts or reward evaluations. This allows AOPD to focus teacher supervision on actions that help the current student while preserving the rollout efficiency of standard OPD. Experiments on math, coding, and Medqa show gains over distillation and RL baselines in both external-teacher and self-distillation settings.
arxiv.titleZh: 何时跟随教师：基于优势的在线策略蒸馏
arxiv.summaryZh: 在线策略蒸馏让教师在学生轨迹的每个状态上都提供监督，默认教师指导总是有益；该工作改为区分教师偏好与实际能帮助学生成功的动作。提出 AOPD：用学生策略下教师动作的反事实优势加权教师监督，且证明仅凭标准学生 rollout 与终端奖励、借教师重要性权重即可无偏估计该目标，无需额外 rollout 或奖励评估。在数学、代码与 Medqa 上，外部教师与自蒸馏两种设定均优于蒸馏与 RL 基线。方法保留了 OPD 的 rollout 效率，为后训练中的 on-policy 蒸馏提供了更细粒度的监督信号。
arxiv.reason: on-policy 蒸馏加优势加权，正击后训练方向

arxiv.title: Diffusion Language Models for Perplexity-Aware Black-Box Attacks
arxiv.abstract: \emph{Continuous-space} attacks find prompts that trigger malicious behaviors, such as overthinking, in black-box LLMs by sampling or optimizing over a low-dimensional Gaussian latent space and decoding it to text through a \emph{random mapping} and nearest-token lookup. Because the random mapping is not learned from language, its prompts can be highly unnatural, and as such easily detectable through input guardrails, and the risk estimates they yield are not grounded in natural prompts. In this paper, we demonstrate that the same continuous latent-space framework can be coupled directly to a learned generative distribution over language, a continuous diffusion language model (dLLM), which removes the artificial random mapping while preserving the standard-Gaussian latent formulation and the downstream sampling or optimization procedure. We evaluate this approach under two settings: sampling-based estimation using \emph{RareTrap} and optimization-based search using \emph{ThinkTrap}. We find that character-level perplexity drops from $10^3$--$10^7$ to 3--5 in RareTrap and from 20--28 to 4.3--5.4 in ThinkTrap. We also find that model risk estimates can differ by an order of magnitude across the two mappings.
arxiv.titleZh: 用于困惑度感知黑盒攻击的扩散语言模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 连续空间黑盒攻击在低维高斯隐空间采样或优化，再经随机映射与最近邻查表解码为文本;但该映射并非学自语言，提示词高度不自然、易被护栏拦截，风险估计也脱离自然分布。把同一隐空间框架接到连续扩散语言模型(dLLM)这一学习到的语言生成分布上，去掉人工随机映射而保留标准高斯隐变量与原有采样、优化流程，在 RareTrap(采样)与 ThinkTrap(优化)两种设置下评估。字符级困惑度从 10³–10⁷ 降至 3–5(RareTrap)、从 20–28 降至 4.3–5.4(ThinkTrap)，两种映射给出的风险估计可相差一个数量级，表明把攻击隐空间锚定到学到的语言分布可让红队评估更贴近真实提示。
arxiv.reason: 用 dLLM 生成自然对抗提示做黑盒红队，属 LLM 安全擦边方向

arxiv.title: Contestable Agents for Data Governance: Recording Human Stewardship of AI-Generated Metadata Across Structured and Unstructured Systems
arxiv.abstract: Industrial organizations hold operational knowledge in structured records, such as telemetry, point lists, and transactions, and in unstructured sources, such as manuals, service notes, communications, and inspection reports. Governance programs often manage these sources separately. Classifying, linking, and documenting them depends on a small group of employees with deep domain knowledge. Agents built on large language models can propose metadata, cite documents, and flag quality issues, but unreviewed proposals can spread errors into downstream systems. A perfunctory approval leaves no record of what a reviewer checked. We present contestable governance: specialist agents produce scored, cited arguments for disputed metadata decisions; a steward can accept, reject, modify, or add arguments before commit; and a governance record retains the evidence, interventions, and outcome. A versioned domain glossary supplies model-specific terms and acronym definitions to the agents. We describe the workflow, a triage path that reserves full argumentation for uncertain proposals while preserving review before commit, the scoring and record models, and a gate that controls which verified decisions become precedent. Two HVAC use cases illustrate the pattern: point classification using Brick Schema class labels, supported by an open reference implementation, and an illustrative warranty failure-mode decision linking claim fields and telemetry to service notes and revisioned bulletins.
arxiv.titleZh: 可争议智能体用于数据治理：记录跨结构化与非结构化系统中 AI 生成元数据的人工管护
arxiv.summaryZh: 工业数据治理中，LLM 智能体提出的元数据建议若未经审查会污染下游系统，而走过场的审批不留审阅痕迹。提出「可争议治理」:专家智能体对有争议的元数据决策给出带评分与引用的论证，数据管家可接受、拒绝、修改或补充后再提交，治理记录留存证据、干预与结果;辅以版本化领域术语表、把完整论证留给不确定提案的分流路径，以及控制哪些已验证决策可成为先例的闸门。以 HVAC 的 Brick Schema 点位分类(附开源实现)与保修失效模式决策为例，演示结构化记录与手册、服务记录等非结构化来源的关联。
arxiv.reason: LLM 智能体落地工业数据治理，属垂直应用，以流程设计为主

arxiv.title: Fine-Grained Analysis of Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Learning via Algorithmic Stability
arxiv.abstract: Understanding catastrophic forgetting, in which learning new tasks degrades performance on previously learned tasks, remains a fundamental challenge in continual learning (CL). Existing theoretical analyses often rely on specific model or task structures and offer limited insight into how iterative optimization affects forgetting. To address this gap, we develop an algorithmic stability framework for expected population forgetting under SGD without prescribing a particular model architecture. Specifically, we decompose forgetting into intra-task and cross-task generalization gaps and empirical forgetting. To bound the generalization gaps, we track how a sample perturbation affects updates within a task and propagates through subsequent tasks. We consider constant, intra-task decaying, and continuously decaying learning-rate schedules. Comparing the two decaying schedules allows us to characterize how restarting learning-rate decay at task boundaries affects the propagation of historical sample perturbations. For empirical forgetting, we derive bounds for all three schedules by retaining cumulative gradient alignment along the optimization trajectory, without requiring convexity. Combining these results yields upper bounds on expected forgetting that capture the effects of training set size, the number of updates per task, the total number of tasks, learning-rate schedules, and cumulative gradient alignment. Finally, we conduct experiments on Split CIFAR-100 and Split MiniImageNet to examine the empirical implications of our theoretical findings.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于算法稳定性的持续学习灾难性遗忘细粒度分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘缺乏与模型结构无关的理论刻画这一问题，构建基于算法稳定性的分析框架，把期望遗忘分解为任务内泛化 gap、跨任务泛化 gap 与经验遗忘三部分;通过追踪单个样本扰动在任务内更新及后续任务中的传播来界定泛化项，并对比恒定、任务内衰减、持续衰减三种学习率调度，说明在任务边界重启衰减如何影响历史扰动的传播;对经验遗忘则在无需凸性假设下保留优化轨迹上的累积梯度对齐来给出界，最终得到显式包含训练集规模、每任务更新步数、任务总数、学习率调度与梯度对齐的遗忘上界，并在 Split CIFAR-100 与 Split MiniImageNet 上做了实证检验。
arxiv.reason: 持续学习遗忘的理论分析，与 LLM 后训练仅间接相关

arxiv.title: Shift-aware score transport for privacy auditing without retraining
arxiv.abstract: Privacy auditing empirically assesses privacy leakage by using membership inference attacks to establish lower bounds on privacy loss. We consider an observational auditing setting in which the auditor cannot insert canaries, control data inclusion, or retrain the target model, and must instead rely on fixed sets of known members and non-members. This setting is relevant for large deployed models or when retraining is restricted by computational or access constraints. In this case, non-members available for auditing may differ in distribution from the training data, causing membership-inference scores to be skewed due to the distribution shift. We address this problem by estimating the counterfactual in-distribution non-member score distribution using the available out-of-distribution (OOD) non-members. Our proposed method learns the relationship between data representations and membership-inference scores from OOD non-members and transports it to the target covariate distribution. Because this transport may become unreliable under extrapolation or imperfect conditional invariance, we further introduce a conservative correction calibrated directly to the nominal transported privacy level. We construct controlled calibration tasks from the available non-member data to estimate how representation-space displacement inflates the audit, and use this estimate to correct the transport-induced audit error. Across multiple datasets with distribution shifts, our method yields substantially more stable privacy estimates while retaining tighter lower bounds than baselines.
arxiv.titleZh: 无需重训练、偏移感知的分数传输隐私审计
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对无法插入canary、控制数据包含或重训练目标模型的观测式隐私审计场景，非成员数据与训练分布不一致会使成员推断分数出现偏移。方法从可得OOD非成员中学习数据表示与成员推断分数之间的关系，并将其传输到目标协变量分布，以估计反事实的分布内非成员分数分布；针对外推与条件不变性不完美导致的传输不可靠，进一步引入直接按名义传输隐私水平校准的保守修正，用非成员数据构造校准任务估计表示空间位移对审计的膨胀效应并加以纠正。在多个存在分布偏移的数据集上，隐私估计更稳定，同时保持比基线更紧的下界。
arxiv.reason: 隐私审计与成员推断，为LLM评测相关但非核心后训练方向

arxiv.title: Same Luck, Different Choice: Twin-World Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning rewards a complete episode, yet the policy needs credit for every decision inside it. Counterfactual branching estimates this credit by re-running the episode after an alternative decision, but the branch draws its sampling noise independently of the factual episode, so the outcome difference mixes the effect of the decision with the luck of everything that follows. We observe that in agentic search the retriever, the corpus, and the grader are deterministic, so an episode is a deterministic function of the policy's decisions and its sampling noise. Twin worlds are therefore realizable: the same noise, a different decision. We introduce TWICE (TWIn-world Credit Estimation), which keys the Gumbel noise of every token by turn and line, rolls out counterfactual twins that inherit the factual episode's downstream noise, and turns their paired outcome differences into turn-level advantages for policy-gradient updates on actor-sampled trajectories; only the actor is deployed. Twin credit is unbiased for any coupling quality, its variance is that of an independent counterfactual scaled by $1-ρ$, where $ρ$ is the twins' outcome correlation, and under coupling the number of rollouts needed to resolve an advantage of size $Δ$ falls from $Θ(Δ^{-2})$ to $Θ(Δ^{-1})$. A square-root rule spends the twin budget where outcomes are predicted to disagree per unit cost. On seven question-answering benchmarks, TWICE improves the average exact match of GRPO by 5.3 and 4.5 points on Qwen2.5-3B and 7B, outperforms tree-search and counterfactual-branching baselines, and uses 68% fewer auxiliary tokens than VinePPO.
arxiv.titleZh: 同样的运气，不同的选择：面向Agentic RL的双世界信用分配
arxiv.summaryZh: Agentic RL只给整条轨迹打分，但轨迹内每一步决策都需要信用。TWICE把每个token的Gumbel噪声按turn与line固定，在相同噪声下更换决策，rollout出继承真实轨迹下游噪声的孪生轨迹，用配对结果差构造turn级优势做策略梯度更新；分析表明估计无偏，方差随孪生相关性ρ以1−ρ缩小，耦合下解析大小为Δ的优势所需rollout数从Θ(Δ⁻²)降到Θ(Δ⁻¹)，并按预测分歧用平方根规则分配预算。在七个问答基准上，Qwen2.5-3B与7B的平均EM较GRPO提升5.3与4.5分，优于树搜索与反事实分支基线，辅助token比VinePPO少68%。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RL信用分配，机制与理论兼有，直击后训练方向

arxiv.title: PYTHIA, a transferable machine learning framework for simultaneous defect and adsorption site optimization
arxiv.abstract: Machine learning has permeated material optimization, providing high value. Nevertheless, its re- liance on a high number of samples limits its applicability to relatively explored material families. In this paper we extend the applicability of machine learning to novel and understudied materials through the PYTHIA (Probabilistic Yet Transferable Hierarchical Interaction Architecture) framework. Pythia utilizes two of the most powerful machine learning concepts, foundational models and transfer learning. We employ a complex foundational model trained on a large dataset of chemically similar molecules, on a target that is physically close to our prediction target. Then, we freeze the weights and perform subspace alignment with the use of a transformer layer and add uncertainty quantification with gaussian processes. These two layers can be trained on a limited dataset yet allow us to leverage the gained knowl- edge and the studied materials and complex architectures. The resulting model is used as a surrogate for a Bayesian Optimization scheme. To showcase the robustness of the framework, we applied it to the investigation of adsorption and defect optimization of two distinct systems. arxiv.titleZh: PYTHIA:面向缺陷与吸附位点同步优化的可迁移机器学习框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对材料家族数据稀缺时机器学习难以适用的问题，PYTHIA 以化学相似分子上预训练的基础模型为起点，冻结权重后用 Transformer 层做子空间对齐，并用高斯过程给出不确定性量化，再作为贝叶斯优化的代理模型。仅需少量数据即可完成迁移，在两类体系的吸附与缺陷优化中高效定位到最优吸附位点。该框架把基础模型与迁移学习引入欠探索材料的同步缺陷—吸附位点搜索，适用于数据有限的功能材料筛选。
arxiv.reason: 材料科学中的迁移学习应用，与 LLM 方向仅方法擦边

arxiv.title: An Empirical Study of Recent Large Language Models for Knowledge Graph to Text Generation on Standard Benchmarks
arxiv.abstract: Knowledge graph-to-text (KG-to-text) generation verbalizes a set of knowledge graph triples into fluent natural language. While fine-tuned encoder-decoder models have long been the standard approach, recent LLMs are becoming increasingly competitive. We benchmark recent LLMs against fine-tuned encoder-decoder models, using reference-based metrics and graph-grounded reference-free LLM-based evaluation validated against human annotations. We observed that recent LLMs substantially narrow, and in several settings close, the gap with fine-tuned models on reference-based metrics, while performing better on graph-grounded metrics. LLM-based evaluation scores show limited correlation with reference-based metrics, suggesting that the two approaches capture different aspects of generation quality. Graph-grounded evaluation reveals that prompted models produce fewer contradictions and triple omissions than fine-tuned models, and these errors increase more rapidly with graph size for fine-tuned models, highlighting differences between the two approaches that reference-based metrics may not fully capture.
arxiv.comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, 17 tables, Preprint, Under review
arxiv.titleZh: 近期大语言模型在标准基准上知识图谱到文本生成的实证研究
arxiv.summaryZh: 知识图谱到文本（KG-to-text）生成需把一组三元组转写为流畅自然语言，微调 encoder-decoder 长期是标准方案，而近期 LLM 的竞争力上升却缺少系统对比。该工作在标准基准上对照评测近期 LLM 与微调 encoder-decoder，同时使用基于参考的指标和以图为依据的无参考 LLM 评测，并用人工标注验证后者可靠性。结果显示 LLM 在参考指标上大幅缩小差距、部分设置下已追平，在以图为依据的指标上反而更优；两类评测分数相关性有限，说明各自捕捉不同侧面的生成质量。细粒度分析表明，prompted 模型的矛盾与三元组遗漏少于微调模型，且微调模型的这类错误随图规模增长得更快，暴露出参考指标难以覆盖的差异。
arxiv.reason: 评测方法学擦边，KG-to-text 属偏门 NLG 任务，增量实证研究

arxiv.title: Beyond Causal Masks: Auditing and Localizing Hidden Future-Token Leakage in Adaptive Sequence Models
arxiv.abstract: Hidden future-token leakage can create false architectural gains: an autoregressive model may appear substantially better under teacher-forced evaluation while its free-running generation deteriorates. We investigate this failure in an adaptive residual-routing decoder whose sequence-level routing summary exposes prefix positions to future tokens despite a correct causal attention mask. An anomalous 24-layer checkpoint reduces validation loss from the baseline's 3.5958 to 1.4259, yet it fails a prefix-invariance audit and has substantially higher reference-model perplexity during generation. Layer-wise diagnostics and implementation inspection trace the violation to a full-sequence summary broadcast through the dynamic routing-query path. Two independently trained 12-layer causal repairs eliminate detectable leakage and return validation loss and reference perplexity to the control scale, removing the large apparent advantage. As diagnostic tools, we use the established prefix-invariance contract, maximum prefix-output discrepancy (LeakScore), complementary behavioral metrics, and layer-wise profiles. Supporting experiments cover six synthetic implementation pairs spanning five module families, clean pretrained controls, controlled fault injection, and cache consistency across numerical precisions. These results illustrate how hidden future-token access can produce misleading claims of architectural progress and why lower teacher-forced loss should be interpreted together with whole-model causal checks and free-running evaluation.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越因果掩码：审计并定位自适应序列模型中的隐藏未来 token 泄漏
arxiv.summaryZh: 审计自适应残差路由解码器中的隐藏未来 token 泄漏：因果注意力掩码虽正确，但序列级路由摘要经动态路由查询路径，把全序列信息广播到前缀位置。异常 24层检查点验证损失由 3.5958 降至 1.4259，却未通过前缀不变性检验，自由生成时参考模型困惑度明显升高；两个独立训练的 12层因果修复消除可检测泄漏，验证损失与参考困惑度回到对照水平。工作给出 LeakScore（最大前缀输出差异）、逐层剖析等诊断工具，并以六组合成实现、故障注入与多精度缓存一致性实验佐证，说明低教师强制损失须与全模型因果检查和自由运行评估结合解读。
arxiv.reason: 针对 LLM 架构中的因果泄漏审计与诊断工具，属训练稳定性与评测方法

arxiv.title: Jev-DLC: Decision-Level Continual Learning from Typed Feedback
arxiv.abstract: Individual preferences often become visible only after deployment, when a user accepts one decision or revokes it in favor of another. Jev-style typed interfaces make this feedback explicit by identifying the selected action and, under revocation, the decision it replaces. We study how these consequences persist across requests as Decision-Level Continual Learning from Typed Feedback (Jev-DLC). Jev-DLC treats each correction as both evidence about a recurring action identity and a directed relation between the preferred and rejected choices. It preserves these signals in complementary bounded channels above a frozen scorer and combines their scores to shape the next decision. The method retains no raw interaction history, adds no scorer call, and performs no runtime language-model backward pass. We also introduce TCPA-Bench, a chronological suite that credits a correction only through its effect on later decisions. On TCPA-Repeat, Jev-DLC reaches 44.83% user-macro accuracy overall, 2.43 points above Recent-4 history replay. After at least two earlier feedback events, it reaches 56.07%, a 7.54-point margin over the strongest reported comparison at this depth. These results show how explicit typed corrections can become compact causal state for continual personalization.
arxiv.titleZh: Jev-DLC:基于类型化反馈的决策级持续学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 用户偏好常在部署后才显现——用户接受某个决策，或撤销它并改选另一个。Jev 式类型化接口把这类反馈显式化:标明所选动作，并在撤销时标明被替换的决策。工作将其形式化为「基于类型化反馈的决策级持续学习」，把每次纠正同时当作关于重复出现动作身份的证据与「偏好—被拒」之间的有向关系，存入冻结打分器之上的有界互补通道并融合打分以影响后续决策，不保留原始交互历史、不增加打分器调用、不做运行时反向传播。作者同时提出按时间顺序评测的 TCPA-Bench，只在后续决策效果上计入纠错;在 TCPA-Repeat 上整体用户宏平均准确率 44.83%，比 Recent-4 历史回放高 2.43 点，在已有至少两次反馈后达 56.07%，领先最强对比 7.54 点。
arxiv.reason: 持续个性化与决策级纠错学习，方向擦边且规模有限

arxiv.title: The Geometry of Metaphor: Probing and Steering Metaphor Representations in Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Metaphor is a crucial aspect of human cognition. As such, we would like to understand how it is represented in large language models (LLMs) and how it might be controlled. We use mechanistic interpretability techniques to identify causal subspaces in a range of LLMs covering different architectures and sizes. We show that we are able to steer output on classification tasks across different parts of speech. We are also able to steer output on generation tasks, indicating that these techniques can be used to control the metaphoricity of LLM output.

arxiv.titleZh: 隐喻的几何：探测与操控大语言模型中的隐喻表征
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究隐喻在大语言模型中如何被表征、能否被控制。用机制可解释性方法在多种架构与规模的开源模型中找到与隐喻相关的因果子空间，并在不同词性的隐喻分类任务上通过子空间干预改变模型输出；在生成任务上同样可操控输出的隐喻程度。说明隐喻性是可定位、可调节的内部特征，为表征层面对齐与风格控制提供了一种可操作的思路。

arxiv.title: From Prompt Rules to Golden Data Model: Production-Scale Generation of Personalized, Compliant Pharmaceutical Claims
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate domain-specific commercial & medical content (e.g., claims, statements, and promotional phrases) in regulated industries such as pharmaceuticals. However, ensuring its regulatory compliance, factual accuracy, and audience-specific personalization remains a major challenge. We report a production case study asking whether moving compliance and personalization signal from prompt-level rules into retrieval time structured context improves pharmaceutical claims generation, using Composer, a deployed internal tool built on a Golden Data Model (GDM) of 1,867 pharmaceutical claims spanning four products. The GDM integrates claim metadata, references, audience labels, material type, usage history, Match Text Variant (MTV) links, and a six dimension quality score (6C). Across six product-audience segments, the context pipeline improves intended indication (+29%), intended content type (+62%) and intended target audience (+67%), 6C quality score (+86%), and claim reuse (+34%). Production log analysis over the deployment period shows a 29.5% reduction in weekly API cost. We report this as descriptive deployment evidence. This work is a systems and data architecture contribution: it shows that in a regulated, high-stakes domain, restructuring claim data for retrieval-time filtering is a more scalable lever than expanding prompt-level rules, and documents the engineering path data cleaning, graph linking, and quality scoring.
arxiv.titleZh: 从提示规则到黄金数据模型:生产规模的个性化、合规制药声明生成
arxiv.summaryZh: 在制药等受监管行业，LLM 生成的商业与医学内容难以靠提示层规则同时保证合规、事实准确与受众个性化。该工作把合规与个性化信号从提示规则迁移到检索时的结构化上下文，基于覆盖 4 个产品、1,867 条制药声明的 Golden Data Model(整合声明元数据、引用、受众标签、素材类型、使用历史、Match Text Variant 链接与六维 6C 质量分)构建内部工具 Composer。六个产品—受众分群上，意图适应症、内容类型、目标受众匹配分别提升 29%、62%、67%,6C 质量分提升 86%，声明复用率提升 34%，上线期周 API 成本下降 29.5%。作为描述性部署证据，它说明在受监管高风险领域重构数据以支持检索时过滤，比扩张提示规则更具可扩展性。
arxiv.reason: 制药合规内容生成，属垂直行业应用，仅与 RAG 上下文设计轻微相关

arxiv.title: Towards User Simulators That Stay On Task And Still Sound Natural
arxiv.abstract: Users increasingly rely on AI systems for extended, multi-turn tasks, yet evidence indicates that LLM-based system performance degrades over prolonged interaction. To evaluate and improve AI assistants in such settings, we need user simulators that faithfully follow complex user intents while exhibiting realistic conversational behavior. Existing approaches manifest a trade-off: prompted assistants can follow complex user intents but lack behavioral fidelity, while specialized user simulators better approximate conversational behavior but struggle to remain faithful to complex intents. In this paper, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) recipe that jointly rewards task intent adherence and behavioral naturalness. A crucial contribution of the method is operationalizing naturalness with a lightweight discriminator trained in an alternating, adversarial loop with the user simulator. We release the resulting model, UserLM-2.0, which produces valid simulated conversations (i.e., meeting both task-faithfulness and naturalness criteria) 46.2% of the time, over three times the rate of the strongest prior user simulator (14.1%).
arxiv.titleZh: 面向既忠于任务又保持自然的用户模拟器
arxiv.summaryZh: 长程多轮交互中 LLM 助手性能会衰减，而现有用户模拟器难以兼顾复杂意图遵循与真实对话行为：提示式助手意图遵循好但行为保真度差，专用模拟器行为像人却常偏离意图。为此提出一套 RL 训练方案，同时奖励任务意图遵循与行为自然度，并用一个轻量判别器在与模拟器交替的对抗循环中训练，把「自然」这一模糊目标操作化为可优化信号。所得模型 UserLM-2.0 生成的对话同时满足任务忠实与自然标准的比例为 46.2%，约为此前最强用户模拟器（14.1%）的三倍。该工作为多轮场景下的助手评测与 Agent 交互数据合成提供了可用的模拟器基座。
arxiv.reason: 用户模拟器 RL 训练，服务多轮 Agent 评测与数据合成，方法扎实

arxiv.title: DuoCook: An Overcooked-Inspired Benchmark for Visual Planning and Coordination
arxiv.abstract: Coordinating two players in a cooking task requires a vision-language agent to track changing scene states, sequence recipe steps, and allocate shared resources under a time budget. We introduce an Overcooked-inspired benchmark for evaluating these capabilities in Unreal Engine environments constructed using coding agents. A single vision-language model controls both players from top-down visual observations, selecting high-level actions while the engine executes navigation. The benchmark contains 20 maps in five categories. These categories support evaluation of centralized coordination under equipment contention, changing terrain, and handoff dependencies. A prop legend and pot ingredient-count indicators provide explicit visual cues, while grid-based destinations support spatial grounding. The evaluation compares four VLMs on all 20 maps, measuring task score, order completion, delivery precision, action acceptance rate, and model API expenditure. A memory ablation on the same 20 maps examines the effect of a shared, self-authored notebook while retaining six-response action history in both conditions. The strongest evaluated model, \texttt{gpt-6-astra}, achieves 26.2\% mean order completion. Notebook memory has mixed score effects across models, with positive mean differences for Claude and Qwen and negative differences for GPT and Gemini.
arxiv.titleZh: DuoCook：一个受 Overcooked 启发的视觉规划与协调基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 双人烹饪协调任务要求视觉语言智能体追踪动态场景、排序食谱步骤并在时间预算内分配共享资源。为此构建了基于 Unreal Engine 的 Overcooked 式基准，由单个 VLM 从俯视视觉观察中同时控制两个玩家，输出高层动作、由引擎执行导航；含 5 类共 20 张地图，覆盖设备争用、地形变化与交接依赖，并提供道具图例、锅中食材计数指示与网格目标以支持空间定位。评测比较 4 个 VLM 的任务得分、订单完成率、交付精度、动作接受率与 API 开销，最强模型 gpt-6-astra 平均订单完成率仅 26.2%；共享自写 notebook 记忆的消融显示对 Claude、Qwen 有正向增益，对 GPT、Gemini 为负。该基准为多智能体视觉规划与记忆机制提供了可诊断的测试环境。
arxiv.reason: VLM 智能体视觉规划与多智能体协调基准，贴近 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: Piano2Pop: Expanding Piano Demos into Pop Productions Without Aligned Supervision
arxiv.abstract: We introduce Piano2Pop, a music-expansion task that transforms piano MIDI into instrumental pop productions. Enabled by recent advances in music generation and polyphonic music transcription, our pseudo-supervised approach conditions a pretrained flow-matching model on piano rolls without aligned piano-pop supervision. We train on synthetic piano-instrumental pairs derived from pop recordings, comparing pair-free transcription, including function-selective (FST) and register-density (RDA) augmentations, with a pair-supervised piano-cover generator as pseudo-demo sources. On 476 testing real-world piano-cover/pop pairs, the pair-supervised approach achieves the best Frechet Audio Distance, Accompaniment Prompt Adherence, and spectral shape on real-piano inputs, while FST mitigates piano-heavy outputs in pair-free training and remains a promising alternative. All fine-tuned systems significantly outperform the zero-shot baselines, which suggests a role for task-specific modeling.
arxiv.titleZh: Piano2Pop:在无对齐监督下将钢琴 demo 扩展为流行音乐制作
arxiv.summaryZh: 将钢琴 MIDI 扩展成带伴奏的流行音乐成品，难点在于缺少钢琴与成品配对的对齐监督。方法是用流行录音合成钢琴-伴奏配对，以伪监督方式在预训练 flow-matching 模型上做条件生成;在无配对音源上比较了转录路线(function-selective FST 与 register-density RDA 增强)和配对监督的钢琴翻奏生成器。在 476 组真实钢琴翻奏/流行成品对上，配对监督方案取得最佳 Frechet Audio Distance、伴奏提示遵循度和频谱形状，FST 缓解了无配对训练中钢琴声过重的问题，所有微调系统都显著优于零样本基线。
arxiv.reason: 音乐生成任务，属音频生成低分方向，与 LLM 关注点无交集

arxiv.title: FairFRESH: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Fair and Explainable Household Food Recommendation
arxiv.abstract: Recommender systems typically serve one user at a time. However, in households, members share a finite pantry and follow different dietary rules, making independent recommendations prone to resource conflicts and dietary violations. We formulate household food recommendation as constrained fair division and present FairFRESH, a neuro-symbolic framework that learns per-member utilities, allocates foods under explicit welfare objectives, enforces dietary rules through a deterministic filter, and explains recommendations using Shapley and Banzhaf attributions. Theoretically, we show that no finite penalty guarantees compliance near a dietary-rule threshold, establish approximation guarantees for greedy allocation under utilitarian and smoothed Nash objectives in the stock-free model before filtering, and characterize the scale invariance of Nash welfare. We also use the minimax theorem to analyze rotating shared meals. On NHANES-derived data, the learned utility model achieves Recall@20 of 0.293, outperforming five learned recommenders (at most 0.244) but not a previous-day repetition heuristic (0.321). On held-out four-person households, Nash allocation reduces Gini disparity by 42% relative to conflict resolution while improving Recall@20 from 0.180 to 0.197. It comes within 2% of an upper bound on the smoothed Nash optimum, and rescaling one member's utilities changes at most 1.5% of assignments. All recommendations satisfy the encoded dietary rules, while attribution scores correlate with utility loss upon component removal (r = 0.76). In simulation, shared meals reduce pantry use by about one-third, and weekly rotation increases the worst-off member's utility by 38% over the best fixed meal.
arxiv.comment: 22 pages, 4 figures. Accepted and presented at ICCIS 2026; this version includes additional theoretical analysis and experiments
arxiv.titleZh: FairFRESH：面向公平且可解释的家庭食物推荐的神经符号框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 家庭场景下成员共享有限食材却遵循不同饮食规则，逐个用户独立推荐容易造成资源冲突与饮食违规，该工作把家庭食物推荐建模为带约束的公平分配问题。FairFRESH 学习各成员的效用函数，在显式福利目标(功利主义与平滑 Nash 福利)下分配食物，用确定性过滤器强制执行饮食规则，并以 Shapley 与 Banzhaf 归因给出解释;理论部分证明在饮食规则阈值附近任何有限惩罚都无法保证合规，并给出无库存模型下贪心分配的近似保证与 Nash 福利的尺度不变性。在 NHANES 衍生数据上，学习效用模型 Recall@20 为 0.293，超过五个学习型推荐器(最高 0.244)但低于前一日重复启发式(0.321);四口之家留出集上 Nash 分配使 Gini 差距相对冲突消解下降 42%,Recall@20 由 0.180 升至 0.197，所有推荐均满足编码的饮食规则，归因分数与组件移除后效用损失相关系数为 r=0.76。
arxiv.reason: 家庭食物推荐垂直应用，与 LLM/Agent 关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: SABLE: Scalable Affine Bayesian Latent-space Exploration
arxiv.abstract: Complex objects such as engineering designs and proteins are often difficult to optimise because their design spaces exhibit high-dimensional structure and objective evaluations are expensive. Generative models provide continuous latent representations, but their latent spaces can have thousands to tens of thousands of dimensions, creating a regime where the latent dimension $D$ greatly exceeds the evaluation budget. We introduce SABLE, a Bayesian optimisation method for high-dimensional latent spaces with an isotropic distribution and limited budget. SABLE uses a Bayesian affine surrogate for prediction and acquisition, treating higher-order structure as surrogate discrepancy. After $N$ observations, the slope update has dimension at most $N-1$, yielding a decomposition of each query into an in-span component optimised by expected improvement (EI) in at most $N$ dimensions and an off-span component governed by a scalar norm. We show that the off-span norm implicitly selected by affine EI can lead to underexploration, and SABLE instead prescribes it using a finite-horizon schedule, without restricting search to a learned subspace. A recompression scheme reduces information to $\mathcal O(M)$ pseudo-observations, bounding refitting cost by $\mathcal O(M^2D+M^3)$ while keeping parameter inference, prediction, and acquisition decisions to tens of milliseconds. Across synthetic benchmarks and latent-space optimisation tasks, SABLE achieves high sample efficiency and reduces decision time by several orders of magnitude at large budgets.
arxiv.titleZh: SABLE：可扩展的仿射贝叶斯隐空间探索
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对隐空间维度远超评测预算的高维贝叶斯优化难题，提出仿射贝叶斯代理模型，将高阶结构视为代理偏差。观测N次后斜率更新维度不超过N-1，从而把每次查询分解为跨度内分量（在至多N维上用期望改进EI优化）与跨度外分量（由标量范数控制），并用有限时域调度显式设定范数以避免探索不足。重压缩方案将信息归约为O(M)个伪观测，拟合代价限制在O(M^2D+M^3)，预测与采集决策保持数十毫秒级。合成基准与隐空间优化任务上样本效率高，大预算下决策时间降低数个数量级。
arxiv.reason: 高维隐空间贝叶斯优化，与LLM后训练仅间接相关

arxiv.title: Training Small Language Models for Transferable Tool Selection
arxiv.abstract: As LLM agents operate over corpora of more than ten thousand tools, selecting the right tool for a complex multi-step user instruction becomes a central bottleneck. Tool descriptions cannot all fit in context, and relevance-based retrievers only rank tools without knowing which are actually needed. Recent work instead leverages proprietary commercial LLMs like Claude or ChatGPT to drive a retriever, decomposing the instruction and selecting over retrieved candidates. We show that a small, open model can be trained via reinforcement learning to perform the same functionality. On ToolBench, a Qwen3-8B model post-trained with our recipe outperforms Llama-4-Maverick (402B). In addition, the trained model transfers directly to different retrievers and generalizes to new tool corpora in different domains.
arxiv.titleZh: 训练小型语言模型实现可迁移的工具选择
arxiv.summaryZh: 面向万级工具库的Agent场景，工具描述无法全部放入上下文，基于相关性的检索器只能排序，并不判断哪些工具真正被需要。该工作以强化学习后训练小型开源模型Qwen3-8B，由它承担指令分解与候选工具选择，替代Claude、ChatGPT等商用大模型驱动的检索流程。在ToolBench上其表现超过402B的Llama-4-Maverick，并能直接迁移到不同检索器、泛化到其他领域的新工具语料。这为低成本、可部署的工具选择提供了可复制的后训练配方。
arxiv.reason: Agent工具选择叠加RL后训练，8B小模型超越402B大模型

arxiv.title: Evaluating the Applicability of LLM Inference Optimizations on Apple Silicon
arxiv.abstract: Apple Silicon is among the most widely used platforms for local LLM inference, yet nearly all inference optimizations are designed and validated on server-class NVIDIA GPUs under batched serving workloads. Which optimizations retain their benefits when moved to Apple Silicon, and what determines their applicability? We evaluate four optimization families: KV-cache pruning, speculative decoding, ported GPU kernels, and post-training quantization. Experiments span four Apple machines under a common single-request decode workload, with matched RTX 4090 comparisons where possible. KV-cache pruning can reach up to 1.75 times end-to-end throughput on Apple but can reduce throughput on desktop NVIDIA GPUs. Under the common benchmark, all evaluated speculative decoding methods reduce throughput on Apple, despite reported 2-6 times gains on server GPUs. CUDA kernel designs transfer only partially: public Metal lacks asynchronous copy, and batch-one decode makes several serving-oriented mechanisms inapplicable, although transferable components yield up to 1.20 times decode throughput. Quantization gains vary by machine. Across four families, a reported speedup is not a portable property of a technique alone but a joint function of technique, runtime, hardware contract, and workload regime.
arxiv.comment: Paper was accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on On-Device Intelligence (ODI) and the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on SLMs for Agentic Systems (SLM-Agents). OpenReview ODI: https://openreview.net/forum?id=Y6fgNlFNL6, OpemReview SLM: https://openreview.net/forum?id=Hhqi8DIZaG
arxiv.titleZh: 评估 LLM 推理优化在 Apple Silicon 上的适用性
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对本地 LLM 推理最常用的 Apple Silicon 平台，系统检验 KV cache 剪枝、投机解码、移植 GPU kernel 与训练后量化四类优化在单请求解码负载下的实际收益，并尽量与 RTX 4090 做匹配对比。结果显示，优化效果并非技术本身的可移植属性：KV cache 剪枝在 Apple 上端到端吞吐最高提升 1.75 倍，在桌面 NVIDIA GPU 上却可能下降；所评测的投机解码方法在 Apple 上全部降低吞吐，与服务器 GPU 上报告的 2 到 6 倍加速相反；Metal 缺少异步拷贝、batch 为 1 使多项面向 serving 的机制失效，可迁移部分仅带来 1.20 倍解码吞吐；量化收益随机器而异。本地推理部署需按运行时、硬件契约与负载区间重新验证优化，不能照搬服务器端结论。
arxiv.reason: 系统评测本地推理优化的跨平台迁移性，属效率方向但为 workshop 级评测

arxiv.title: From Structured Records to Patient Narratives: Preserving Clinical Alignment in LLM-Generated Health Summaries
arxiv.abstract: As wearable and digital health systems increasingly generate longitudinal physiological records, communicating these observations in patient-accessible language remains a significant challenge. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising mechanism for translating structured clinical information into readable narratives, but this process may introduce semantic drift, where clinically precise meaning is distorted during simplification. We investigate evidence-grounded health summarization for menstrual health monitoring using a constrained generation framework that combines structured evidence conditioning with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using a prompt-based constrained generation framework. We evaluate semantic alignment using Natural Language Inference (NLI), atomic factuality metrics, and readability measures. Across three LLMs and 4,500 generated summaries, explicit grounding constraints consistently improve clinical alignment, particularly by improving uncertainty preservation and, once faithfulness is evaluated against retrieved evidence, generally preserving or improving faithfulness, while effects on omission remain model-dependent. We also find that improved clinical alignment comes at the cost of increased reading difficulty and medical terminology. These findings highlight the need to jointly evaluate faithfulness, uncertainty preservation, and readability when developing patient-facing medical LLM systems.
arxiv.titleZh: 从结构化记录到患者叙述：在 LLM 生成的健康摘要中保持临床一致性
arxiv.summaryZh: 可穿戴设备产生的纵向生理记录需要转写成患者可读的叙述，而 LLM 在简化过程中容易出现语义漂移。工作以月经健康监测为场景，将结构化证据条件与基于提示的约束生成框架、RAG 结合，并用 NLI、原子事实性指标与可读性度量进行评估，覆盖 3 个 LLM 生成的 4500 条摘要。结果显示显式接地约束能稳定提升临床一致性，尤其改善不确定性保留，在对照检索证据评估时忠实度总体维持或提升，遗漏情况则随模型而异。代价是可读性下降、医学术语增多，说明面向患者的医疗 LLM 系统需联合评估忠实度、不确定性保留与可读性。
arxiv.reason: 医疗健康摘要的垂直应用，与后训练／Agent 主线交集有限

arxiv.title: RheOPT: Few-Shot Non-Newtonian Flow Prediction via Newtonian Pretraining of RheOFormer
arxiv.abstract: Despite advances in numerical methods, non-Newtonian flow simulations remain computationally expensive because velocity and stress must be advanced together through rate- and history-dependent constitutive dynamics. Neural-operator surrogates reduce inference cost after training, but their training data require the same expensive simulations they aim to replace, making data-efficient learning essential when only a few non-Newtonian simulations can be afforded. Here, we introduce the Rheological Operator Pretrained Transformer (RheOPT), which pretrains a transformer-based neural operator on inexpensive Newtonian simulations and fine-tunes it on a small number of non-Newtonian samples. Rather than transferring the Newtonian constitutive response itself, RheOPT reuses geometry-conditioned transport structure that remains useful after the stress model changes. We evaluate RheOPT in two geometry-matched settings: a $4{:}1$ contraction channel for Giesekus, Oldroyd-B, and Bingham fluids, and the oscillatory wake behind a triangular obstacle for Oldroyd-B flow. In the contraction, Newtonian pretraining substantially improves few-shot prediction, and a model fine-tuned on four target samples can match or exceed a from-scratch model trained on four times as many. This benefit is reliable under reversible instance normalization (RevIN) but dataset dependent under Global normalization, a difference we trace to the dynamic range of each fluid's velocity and stress fields. In the wake, where relative $L_2$ error alone cannot verify that vortex shedding is recovered, phase-insensitive diagnostics show that pretraining recovers the shedding frequency and wake fluctuation amplitude that are suppressed by the from-scratch model in the few-shot regime. Overall, RheOPT establishes Newtonian simulation as a physically grounded pretraining source for data-efficient non-Newtonian operator learning.
arxiv.titleZh: RheOPT：经由 RheOFormer 的牛顿流体预训练实现少样本非牛顿流体流动预测
arxiv.summaryZh: 非牛顿流仿真需要同时推进速度场与应力场，计算代价高昂，而神经算子代理模型的训练数据本身又依赖同类昂贵仿真，因此少样本条件下的数据高效学习成为关键。RheOPT 先把基于 transformer 的神经算子放在廉价的牛顿流仿真上预训练，再在少量非牛顿样本上微调，迁移的是几何条件化的输运结构而非牛顿本构响应本身。在 4:1 收缩通道（Giesekus、Oldroyd-B、Bingham 流体）中，用 4 个目标样本微调的模型可匹敌甚至超过用 4 倍样本从头训练的模型，且该收益在 RevIN 归一化下稳定、在 Global 归一化下依赖数据集；在三角障碍尾流中，相位不敏感诊断显示预训练恢复了从头训练模型在少样本下压制的涡脱落频率与脉动幅值。该工作把牛顿流仿真确立为数据高效非牛顿算子学习的物理基础预训练来源。
arxiv.reason: 神经算子做流体仿真预训练迁移，属物理仿真，仅架构层面沾边

arxiv.title: Adaptive Skill Granularity for Coding Agents: Runtime Routing and Macro-to-Micro Recovery
arxiv.abstract: Reusable skills allow large language model agents to package task-specific procedures, tool affordances, and execution guidance into modular units. Prior work has largely studied how agents retrieve, compose, or synthesize skills before execution. In coding agents, however, execution poses an additional runtime control problem: the same task may be solved through primitive tool calls, macro skills, or hybrid execution that starts with a macro and falls back to micro-level recovery. We introduce Adaptive Skill Granularity, a framework that treats skill granularity as an action-abstraction policy conditioned on task structure, execution state, and macro-skill failures. The system combines a feature-based granularity controller and a finite-state recovery executor. We evaluate the framework with a deterministic coding-agent protocol using verifier-defined success, total cost, and process metrics such as macro adoption, failure recovery, route match, and transition correctness. Results show that fixed macro execution is efficient when applicable but brittle under mismatch, while runtime routing and explicit macro-to-micro recovery improve robustness and recover controlled macro failures that fixed-granularity execution leaves unresolved. Our findings suggest that skill libraries for coding agents should be treated not only as retrievable resources, but also as controllable, verifiable, and recoverable execution abstractions.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向编程智能体的自适应技能粒度：运行时路由与宏到微恢复
arxiv.summaryZh: 解决编程智能体执行时的技能粒度选择问题：同一任务可由原子工具调用、宏技能或混合执行完成，固定粒度在失配时脆弱。做法是把技能粒度视为动作抽象策略，用基于特征的粒度控制器与有限状态恢复执行器，按任务结构、执行状态和宏技能失败在运行时路由。在确定性编程智能体协议下，以验证器判定成功率、总成本及宏采用率、失败恢复、路由匹配等过程指标评测，运行时路由与宏到微恢复相比固定粒度提升了鲁棒性。技能库因此应被视为可控、可验证、可恢复的执行抽象，而非仅是可检索资源。
arxiv.reason: 编程智能体的技能抽象与运行时控制，命中Agent方向

arxiv.title: Multi-Token Prediction and Alternative Tokenization Improve Learning Latent Multi-Hop Graph Search at Scale
arxiv.abstract: Given an unseen graph, a start node, $s$, and an end node, $t$, can a language model generate the shortest path from $s$ to $t$? Prior work has found that models fail to learn this task as the graphs scale. We show that this failure has two causes: the supervision signal and the tokenization. First, we theoretically establish and empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-token prediction (MTP), and show that the benefits of MTP are topologically agnostic. Second, we introduce alternative tokenizations and show that the two causes are orthogonal. Using these methods, we break through the scaling wall observed by prior work, consistently and stably learning to solve the task at scales far beyond previous limits.

arxiv.titleZh: 多 token 预测与替代分词改进大规模隐式多跳图搜索学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 给定未见过的图与起止节点，语言模型能否直接生成最短路？此前研究发现图规模一大模型就学不会。该工作指出失败源于监督信号与分词两点：理论上建立并实验验证多 token 预测（MTP）的有效性，且其收益与图拓扑无关；同时引入替代分词方案，并证明两个成因相互正交。二者结合后突破了此前的规模墙，在远超以往极限的规模上稳定一致地学会该任务。
arxiv.reason: MTP 与分词影响 LLM 图推理，命中架构与推理方向

arxiv.title: DIAL: Steerable Language Models with Distilled Instruction-Adherence Levels
arxiv.abstract: When a user says "Keep it short", how short should the LLM's response be? More generally, users and applications require different levels of instruction adherence, but prompting does not reliably provide fine-grained control over them. We therefore study "steerable language models" that provide fine-grained numerical control over the degree to which models follow general instructions specified in text. However, existing approaches do not jointly offer fine-grained control, efficiency, and scalability across diverse instructions. To address this gap, we introduce DIAL (Distilled Instruction-Adherence Levels) to achieve all three properties. For fine-grained control, we perform classifier-free guidance (CFG) with a frozen LLM to provide training signals for on-policy distillation of instruction adherence at different levels. For efficiency, we design a lightweight steering adapter that uses a classifier over the LLM's hidden states to compute a closed-form steering edit. The classifier adaptively sets the steering magnitude at each token based on the target adherence level, while accounting for the geometry of the LLM's hidden states to preserve response coherence. For scalability, the classifier is text-conditioned, allowing a shared adapter to support new instructions without per-instruction fitting, and training requires only instruction and request text. Evaluation across multiple LLM families shows that DIAL achieves a competitive balance between concept expression and response fluency, with concept scores increasing monotonically across adherence levels. We introduce SteerIF, an instruction-only dataset of 98, 625 concept, persona, verifiable, and descriptive instructions. When trained on SteerIF, DIAL provides fine-grained control over personas and, when combined with prompting, improves verifiable instruction following.
arxiv.comment: This paper introduces DIAL, a framework for fine-grained, efficient, and scalable control of LLM instruction adherence
arxiv.titleZh: DIAL：通过蒸馏指令遵循程度实现可操控的语言模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 提示词无法对「多严格地遵循指令」给出细粒度数值控制，现有方法也难以同时兼顾细粒度、效率与可扩展性。DIAL 用冻结 LLM 的 classifier-free guidance 产生不同遵循程度的训练信号，再以 on-policy 蒸馏训练一个轻量 steering adapter:该适配器基于 LLM 隐状态上的分类器计算闭式 steering 修正，按目标程度逐 token 自适应调整幅度并考虑隐状态几何以保持连贯。分类器以文本为条件，共享适配器即可泛化到新指令，训练只需指令与请求文本。多模型族评测显示概念表达与流畅度取得较好平衡，概念得分随遵循程度单调上升;作者还发布含 98,625 条指令的 SteerIF 数据集，训练后可控人设，配合提示可提升可验证指令遵循。
arxiv.reason: on-policy 蒸馏加隐状态 steering 的可控性后训练工作，切中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Conservative Meta-Agent Search: Architecture Adaptation under Non-Stationarity
arxiv.abstract: Automated agentic-system design is typically evaluated on static task suites with immediate scalar rewards. Deployed systems face persistent shift, delayed dependent feedback, correlated component failures, and costly architecture changes. We formalize meta-agent architecture search as sequential incumbent replacement with switching costs and hard risk constraints and introduce Conservative Meta-Agent Search (CMAS). CMAS retrieves archived architectures and proposes typed graph edits, then scores each against the incumbent by paired shadow replay under common random numbers, with interventional component credit. Promotion requires an empirically calibrated, variance-penalized simultaneous score above a pre-specified margin, and is followed by a simulated canary stage and pre-specified rollback. Since backtests cannot certify meta-level skill, we introduce MetaInvest-Bench, a regime-switching simulator whose specified worker competence makes a surrogate-optimal architecture computable, with leakage-controlled replay, adversarial governance tracks, and five negative controls. Financial streams serve as a risk-sensitive testbed for meta-level generalization; we claim no alpha. Across 96 streams, CMAS cuts normalized mean surrogate dynamic-oracle regret from 0.116 to 0.104 and raises held-out utility from 0.44 to 0.48 over the strongest adaptive baseline; when extra workers add no value, it contracts to near-single-agent teams. Its deployment inference cost is ~6% lower, though its search-inclusive token cost is the highest of the methods compared. The observed per-update false-promotion rate is 3.4% against a nominal 5% target, and 4.8% in a sealed rerun. The calibration is empirical: it concerns an update-level replay statistic on an author-designed benchmark, and guarantees neither full-utility improvement, nor absence of simulated canary-stage harm, nor sequence-level error control.
arxiv.titleZh: 保守型元智能体搜索：非平稳条件下的架构适配
arxiv.summaryZh: 部署中的 agent 系统架构搜索多在静态任务集与即时标量奖励下评估，忽略分布漂移、延迟反馈、组件相关失效与切换成本。工作将元智能体架构搜索形式化为带切换成本与硬风险约束的序贯现任替换：检索历史架构并生成类型化图编辑，用共同随机数下的配对影子回放打分，经方差惩罚的校准阈值晋级，并辅以模拟 canary 与预定义回滚。在 96 条数据流上把归一化动态 oracle regret 从 0.116 降至 0.104，留出效用从 0.44 升至 0.48，部署推理成本低约 6%，每次更新的误晋级率为 3.4%（密封重跑 4.8%）；当额外 worker 无增益时会收缩至近单 agent 团队。配套 MetaInvest-Bench 提供可计算代理最优架构的 regime-switching 模拟与五组负对照，适用于持续演化 agent 架构的治理与评测。
arxiv.reason: Agent 架构搜索与非平稳评测基准，直接命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Drift Says When, Budget Says How Much: Rate-Controlled KV Re-selection for Long-Form Multimodal Generation
arxiv.abstract: KV cache compression for multimodal LLMs usually selects the visual tokens to keep once, at prefill, and reuses that selection for the whole generation. We show that this one-shot selection is severely limited on long-form generation: on detailed image description, even an oracle that selects with the attention of the uncompressed answer reaches only 0.44-0.52 ROUGE-L agreement with the uncompressed output, because the evidence the model reads moves as the description unfolds. Re-selecting whenever attention drifts out of the kept set is the natural remedy, but we find that a fixed drift threshold fails systematically: drift magnitudes are not comparable across samples, so low-drift samples are almost never refreshed although they benefit the most. We propose Rate-Controlled Refresh (RCR), which lets drift decide when and where to re-select while a per-sample controller regulates how often, combined with a low-rank drift detector, candidate-restricted re-selection, and a decision that stays on the GPU. With one setting for all models and tasks, RCR outperforms the per-step retrieval method InfiniGen by 1.6-3.8 ROUGE-L points on five of six model-task settings with no significant difference on the sixth, while staying within 1.7 points of exact per-step re-selection, with comparable estimated data movement per step and a 4x smaller GPU-resident detector. On DetailCaps, drift-chosen timing beats random timing at the same refresh rate and periodic timing even at a higher rate, by 2.0-5.0 points. On pre-registered video description, where drift is homogeneous across samples, RCR is on par with InfiniGen on Qwen2-VL and exceeds it on Qwen3-VL but no longer beats a fixed threshold at the nearest tested rates, consistent with the diagnosis; object-level evaluation shows that RCR achieves higher object F1 against the uncompressed output than InfiniGen on two of three models.
arxiv.titleZh: 漂移决定何时，预算决定多少：面向长文本多模态生成的速率受控KV重选
arxiv.summaryZh: 多模态LLM的KV cache压缩通常在prefill阶段一次性选定要保留的视觉token并在整段生成中沿用，但在长文本生成中，模型依赖的证据会随描述推进而转移，即使以未压缩答案的注意力做oracle选择，与未压缩输出的ROUGE-L一致度也只有0.44–0.52。为此提出Rate-Controlled Refresh（RCR）：由注意力漂移决定何时、在何处重选，再用逐样本控制器调节刷新频率，配合低秩漂移检测器、候选受限重选与全程驻留GPU的决策。在六组模型-任务设定中的五组上比逐步检索方法InfiniGen高1.6–3.8个ROUGE-L点，与精确逐步重选的差距在1.7点以内，检测器显存占用缩小4倍；DetailCaps上按漂移选时机在同一刷新率下优于随机时机。
arxiv.reason: KV cache压缩与多模态推理效率，方法完整实验充分

arxiv.title: PhysTrace: Interpretable Temporal Evaluation of Physical Consistency in Video Generative Models
arxiv.abstract: World action models increasingly rely on pretrained video models assumed to capture physical dynamics for prediction, planning, and action generation. Existing evaluations assess plausibility, probe representations, or measure predictive surprise, but rarely identify which history-conditioned physical expectations conflict with observations. We introduce PhysTrace, a training-free framework aligning MLLM-generated, history-conditioned expectations with observed video windows to temporally localize physical violations and provide interpretable descriptions without task-specific probes or classifiers. We also introduce IntPhys2-Timing, adding violation intervals to IntPhys2. PhysTrace achieves a Hit Rate of up to 70.7% across physical principles on IntPhys2-Timing and outperforms the compared methods in overall possible-impossible discrimination accuracy on IntPhys2. Applied to reconstructed videos along the trajectories of pretrained diffusion/flow-based video models, PhysTrace reveals attribute- and noise-dependent patterns in physical violation localization, enabling interpretable physical consistency analysis across timesteps.
arxiv.comment: 17 pages, 7 figures (including supplementary material). Code: https://github.com/PhysTrace/PhysTrace
arxiv.titleZh: PhysTrace：视频生成模型中物理一致性的可解释时序评估
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对世界动作模型依赖预训练视频模型捕捉物理动态、却缺少对「哪段历史条件下的物理预期与观察冲突」进行定位的评估手段这一问题，提出免训练框架 PhysTrace：用 MLLM 生成以历史为条件的物理预期，再与观察到的视频窗口对齐，从而在时间上定位物理违规并给出可解释描述，无需任务专用探针或分类器。同时发布 IntPhys2-Timing，为 IntPhys2 增加违规时间区间标注。在 IntPhys2-Timing 上，各物理原则的命中率最高达 70.7%，在 IntPhys2 上的整体可能/不可能判别准确率优于对比方法。将该框架用于扩散/流式视频模型沿轨迹重建的视频，可揭示物理违规定位随属性与噪声变化的规律。
arxiv.reason: 视频生成物理一致性评估，属视觉生成方向，仅方法与评测沾边
